title: I finally found my holy grail dark green hair color! I love the muted shade range.
text:
I have been looking for a dark, truly green hair dye for ages. Most dark greens skew hard teal,and mixing colors to get the desired shade usually fades to blue annoyingly fast. Green Tomato is the color of tomato vines and is very pigmented—it's such a dark green that it looks almost black when it comes out of the tube. It has a gray undertone rather than a blue or yellow one. I love this color. It's a muted, deep green that fades to a dark mossy tone after many washes. The result is a more natural, "lived-in" color right from the start.

The dye has a gel-like consistency that makes it very spreadable. I have shoulder-length, fine hair. Even using this completely undiluted and unmixed, I will get at least a dozen uses out of this one tube. I've used it undiluted to achieve a dark green that passes for black in dim or soft lighting. (Side Note: be careful to avoid applying undiluted dye directly to your scalp, this stains your skin quite badly.) I've diluted it with white, silicone-free conditioner to create a pastel version. Using a lot of conditioner creates a slightly grainy mixture, but it hasn't affected the quality or longevity of the results. I've also mixed it with several other brands of dye (e.g. Pravana, Iroiro, La Riche Directions, and Bigen Vivid Shades) with no issues and positive results. It smells sort of like markers, with a hint of perfume. It's not particularly terrible, but it's one of the worst-smelling brands of semi-permanent hair color I've come across.

I really think Sarangsae is doing something special with the shade range they offer. I've used over a dozen brands in all the colors of the rainbow, but nobody else is creating such soft, understated colors. It's not too hard for me to achieve a soft pastel (either by using a pastel dye or diluting a dark dye) but dark shades are usually extremely bright. I love mixing my own colors, and the hardest thing to achieve is a muted dark hue. I've added silver dyes,the Pravana Vivids "black" additive, and/or small amounts of opposing shades (i.e., a dab of pink or light orange to a green to tone it down) with various success. I'm really excited to try some of their other muted colors in the future, like Black Rose, Deep Grey, or Mustard Yellow. If they can make a truly soft, deep, dark green, they can probably make any shade!

title: Nice but not for sensitive skin
text:
This is the first time that I've used a mask from this line. And I have to admit that the packaging influenced my purchase:)
I really like the feel of the serum and the light fragrance. I, unlike other reviewers, couldn't fit it over my ears. Also the eye holes were way too small. Tip: use the peeI off backing and laid it on my neck and chest.
Left it on for 10 minutes and when I removed it I have small bumps all over my face, but now after 30 minutes, they seem to be going away. Once the serum dries it does feel a little tight on your face but it does not dry out the skin. I finished with a rich moisturizer to "seal the deal." The next morning my face felt very soft but still had a few bumps around the mouth area. My advice would be for those who have dry, sensitive skin, might want to be weary of this mask. Not the mask's fault, mind you, just not a good match for my skin. I would have given it 5 stars but took one off because of the bumps...

title: Great Toothbrush, Especially for College
text:
I've used this toothbrush, the essence 5600, and the flexcare r910. The flexcare is more powerful and has better brush heads (it also avoids the problem of having water trapped inside the brush and growing mold), but it's also far more expensive. The essence 5600 is a waste of money in my opinion as it has the same performance as this toothbrush, but suffers from a shoddy li-on battery that dies after about a year or so of use. This avoids the battery problem by using replaceable AA batteries and lasts quite a while on each replacement.

The only major con is with the brush head design. There is a a gap between the brush body and head, and this gap tends to fill with water after use. This unfortunately leads to black mold growing in the cavity. It's easy to avoid this by simply unscrewing the head after brushing and rinsing out the cavity, but it's an annoyance nonetheless.

All in all, this is a great cheap way to get the benefits of sonicare.

title: Fight night sweats
text:
I've put up with night sweats for many years, toughing it out, tossing off sheets, occasionally running my hands under cold water or using a cold washcloth when it got bad. These pads are a perfect non-medication -- and dry! -- solution. I bought two. They stay by my bedside and when I get too hot, I place them under my knees or neck, wherever I think they will help. They are thin and comfortable and keep cool for several minutes, enough to cool me down. I've never put them in the fridge. That might be too much for me. A few minutes back out in the air, and they are ready to cool again. I've had them a few days, so this is not a review about their long-term reliability. I'll post back later on that. Four stars until I see if they continue to work.

A month later...
The pad works very well. It won't hold a chill forever, but usually enough to halt a hot flash or nightsweat. The room temp affects the success. It's summer and, although I have central air, sometimes it"s a bit warm (and my whole body temp is warmer) and the pad heats up faster. It also takes longer to cool down in that circumstance. That's why I'm glad I bought two. I don't fret about night sweats anymore. These are a good, affordable solution.

The best spots for me to place the pads are: back of my knees and under my feet.

title: Proprietary Formula??!! Beware!
text:
I do NOT recommend this product!! It contains a “special formula contains perfumer's alcohol and other proprietary ingredients” as stated in its description, which I overlooked! I’m sorry but if this product uses “proprietary ingredients” it is unacceptable! With people’s allergies and sensitivities to different chemicals (especially) I believe that some of the “proprietary ingredients” should be labeled!! Even extremely large corporations like C***ke for one, who do have a proprietary/ “secret” formula for their flavored syrup list ALL the other ingredients in their products! I realize that this item is from a small company, HOWEVER! This would have been used in conjunction with my essential oils to create my scented items for my customers, my friends, and my family! I CANNOT use and do NOT recommend a cosmetic component such as this specific product for use nor purchase!

I ended up using a 1:1 ratio of distilled water to high proof grain alcohol (173 proof/ approximately 76% alcohol) [the highest proof alcohol legal in my state, some states allow for higher proof vodkas and grain alcohols, the higher the proof, the better] with my oils in an amber, pump style bottle and just reminded people (and printed on label) to shake well before use.

I contacted Amazon and explained the situation, as the item is listed as “non- returnable”, (I believe due to its flammability [although it came via USPS!!!]) and received a refund from Amazon! Thank you Amazon for understanding!

title: A True Gentleman's Walking Stick
text:
Alpacca is also named German Silver or Nickle Silver. Consisting mostly of copper, nickle and zinc content. In my brief research I find that Alpacca does not contain any actual silver. Though some may be silver plated. But do not think of it as cheap imitation silver. It is more akin to a subset of brass.

This Alpacca cane is the pricier big brother to the plastic headed walking stick of the same design. The plastic brethren of this stick was love at first sight. The flared head and modest fluting simply screams elegance. Nowhere have I found a more elegant walking stick for the 'top hat' era.

As reported with flared head sticks, it is better suited for show. The slightly rounded top makes putting any kind of real pressure uncomfortable without leather gloves. However, it does provide modest balance if weight bearing is not your walking issue. The silvery smooth head does not make the cane top heavy.

The rubber tip is pretty standard and is useful for standing the 3/4" wide cane on flat surfaces. On the negative side, it takes away from the distinctiveness and gives an "old man" quality. I ordered my cane through a vendor who does silver ferrules (plated brass tips) and upgraded the business end of this cane to become a "Gentleman's Walking Stick". Silver ferrules raise the value and elevate the distinctive beauty.

This Alpacca cane lacks the distinctive charm of a chrome collar. My vendor states he routinely heats up such heads for removal, but the extra cost hardly seems worth the upgrade. It was mostly due to removal of the head. Unlike the screw top plastic cane, the Alpacca head is hollow and intended for permanent mounting, using pitch.

As it stands, this cane is suited for mild assisted walking. Use it more for classy strolls, theater, special occasions and dancing. Do not forget the white leather gloves!

Addendum:
On Saturday, 2/7/2015 I finally revealed this walking stick for a big birthday celebration. My black and white clothing style makes me look good, but there is a "whoa" factor when seen with this stick and a pair of white leather gloves. It helps that I had the tip refined with a ferrule and small rubber tip. I love it.

title: Tangles so easily
text:
When I first bought this hair it was soft and beautiful. Within one week the breakage was incredible- 1-2 inches gone. Some strands broke almost up to the brown.
It constantly knots up. If I wear it down I have to be running my fingers through it constantly. Hair coming out everywhere.
I bought three bundles and lost about one bundle in shedding after 4 weeks of wearing it. I use a wide tooth comb to brush followed by a paddle brush. So I’m trying to be gentle but it doesn’t matter. I leave my hair alone for 5 seconds and it tangles.
I’ve tried 3 different shampoos (one was all natural) and I use it’s a 10 for my conditioner. My natural hair is out on the top and it is super soft and this hair feels like hay. It doesn’t even feel real. I’ve been wearing it in a bun or braid and it’s still tangles when I take it down.
I’m really tired of feeling like I’m wearing an old Halloween wig or something. I only got one month out of these bundles ($300 worth) and I’m very upset. This is also my first time wear a sew in and I feel like it ruined my experience. I can’t wait to get this hair out of my head.

title: Love love love!
text:
So I am super sweaty and tend to stink by the end of the day and I don't do much because I'm unable to work due to medical issues. I've tried many deodorants even men's and prescription and nothing helped. I then started to worry about breast cancer because of how far down I was having to put deodorant. I tried probably 5 natural deodorant and none of them worked! I smelled horrible! Even after detoxing my pits a few times it was still bad. Then I found this product. WOW! I don't stink at all! And I even feel like I'm sweating less! I love this so much! I got lavender and lemon. It does go on super wet! So make sure you give it time to dry before dressing. I have found no stains from it. Will buy over and over again!
*It's great to detox when switching to natural deodorant to get chemicals out that may be causing you to stink and sweat more (they can do that). Try using apple cider vinegar mixed with bentonite clay to make a paste. Start with 5 min or less on underarms and wash off. Then apply some aloe gel. Can extend time after a couple uses. Do it a few times the first week but don't over do it. Then 1x a month for a few.

title: Seems like it is built to last
text:
The table itself is very solid and heavy. Seems like it is built to last. It came packaged very well and was delivered on a pallet. The size is really good, plenty of room on the table top and leg room is ample. The table does not rock, but sits firmly, proving it was built square. The built in vent is very helpful. When my wife and sister do each others nails they would often joke that they were going to die from all the nail dust....well this vent will now prevent an early death!

The desk itself has two outer drawers that slide out. The one in the middle tilts out and is simply an access cubby to turn the vent switch on and off.

The critiques I have are minor. 1) The glass top didn't fit the table top exactly...it was off by a little, maybe 1/8". I flipped it over to see if it fit better and it was still off. The vent still fit in the hole ok. 2) There is no 1 1/2" hole inside the middle cubby to allow the electrical cord to go through so you can plug it in to an outlet. I'll have to drill that myself. I'm also going to do some other "convenience" modifications which involve installing more outlets near the bottoms of the legs so there won't be cords draped all around for the lamp, UV, Dremel, and fan. There will essentially be one cord providing power to the table, and then the other accessories will plug into the table.

Overall, I give it a 4 1/2 stars rating. If the glass fit better and the middle cubby had an access hole for the fan cord, that would make it a 5 star. I can't choose 4 1/2 so i'll mark it a 5. It's more 5 than 4 anyways.

I guess I could talk about the money a bit. Yes, this was expensive. $400 plus $150 s/h plus $65 to deliver to a residential address (which I didn't know about. To the manufacturer: you should disclose this additional cost upfront). No matter what table I looked at, they all were going to have a high shipping cost. So then it was a matter of choosing between a $200 table and $400 and up because for some reason these manicure tables are expensive, even the cheap plywood models on wheels. So I opted to pay more for quality. It seems like it will last as long as we need it, and it matches the decor of the room.

I attached a picture for size comparison. My wife didn't want her face in it though...:)

title: Love it
text:
I was ready for a change in my hair care products. I tried a different all natural product but didn't like how it made my hair feel. I bought Morrocco Method's Starter Kit wanting to like it. I read up on their products before purchasing and liked that it was vegan and raw and that I actually had some inkling as to what the ingredients are.

After buying the kit, I went back to their website while waiting for it to arrive and watched their videos and the testimonials. I wasn't looking for anything negative - because I wanted to like it. I was looking for how other people were using the product, what they found worked for them and how Morrocco Method recommended using the product. This worked out very well for me in that I picked up a few tips.

I've now been using the shampoos and conditions for 6 days. Your hair and scalp does go through a transitionary phase while your scalp gets used to not having to produce as much hair oil since you're not stripping it from your hair with synthetic shampoos. I had started with the other product I was using about 2 weeks before starting with Morrocco and my hair was very oily and heavy after starting that. I'm hoping I've gotten through most of the transition because I've only had 1-2 days with Morrocco where my hair has been oily. The other days my hair has looked awesome. My scalp has felt lighter too!

It's an adjustment to learn how to use their shampoos. For example, they don't lather up. I expected this and don't have an issue with it. The first day I used a Morrocco shampoo my hair felt really oily and greasy. I didn't see how the shampoo would get my hair feeling clean, but it did. Not only was it clean, but felt smooth and silky.

I've now ordered the larger sizes of the shampoos and will continue to use them.

text:
PROS: close shave; less skin irritation and no cut; quick and easy cleaning

CONS: long charging time; pricy cartridges; fragile looking body

With this shaver, I've had the closest shaves! It only took me several days for my face to get used to it. Blade razors, like Mach 3, give better shaves but they usually leave cuts on my face so this has been great. The shaving time is actually shortened for me because I just do it during the shower, and so easy to clean. Nevertheless, 8 hours are too long for charging- pricier 7775X model only takes 1 hour. Also the plastic body looks very fragile. Like others said, Nivea cartridges can run out fast. But I found a remedy- Nivea "after shave balm" 3.3 oz. at $4.79 in a local CVS pharmacy gives you the same quality as little five Nivea 0.4 oz. cartridges(total 2 oz.) at $5 do. I have a sensitive skin and Nivea sensitive "after shave balm" has been great. I hope this helps.

title: Not a real human hair
text:
Here is my honest review:
I wanted to add some length to my short and damaged hair so after some research decided to purchase tape in extensions. I scheduled an appointment with the professional who could install these. My first mistake was that I didn't read those negative reviews for these tape-ins. Wish I did. Hair looked good at first, soft and the color was matching mine. It came with some extra tape-ins. After the appointment, I loved the hair. However, my stylist said this was not real human hair but quality synthetic hair. I didn't believe her.
As recommended I used 1 pack of 100 grams and 2 packs of 30 so the total was 160 grams and I have tin hair. Waited 4 days and washed my hair. It wasn't as hard as expected. One extension came off. I replaced a tape in and reinstalled myself. Wasn't hard. The first two days I had a headache I guess because of the extra weight. It went away on the third day. After I dried my hair, the extensions were dry and curly. I purchased straight hair. Used an iron to straighten it out. After 7 days my scalp was itchy and the bumps were all over the scalp due to the glue in the tape-ins. At that point, I just wanted them out. Thank God I was able to find a good tape in remover. Ladies these are not real human hair extensions. Save your money. I attached the picture for reference.

title: IF your blowdryer is a match for this diffuser, you are going to want it for lift and volume. Nothing else compares.
text:
Several years ago I had purchased a blowdryer with a similar attachment. I absolutely adored that thing - you could use it on the top of your hair or the sides to give lift so your hair had volume without using any product or doing any backbrushing. The thing was a miracle worker!

Then we entered the era of pin straight hair, and volume and body were out. Thank God, we seem to be passing that era, but hairstyling implements seem to be lagging behind. I was dying to try this diffuser to see if it emulated the gizmo from long ago, and it does. Well made hair styling tool that gives lift and volume to your hair, I love it. Well, kinda.

I'm not sure how 'universal' this is. I tried it on my current blowdryer, and it didn't fit. I had to go digging around until I finally found a Conair dryer upon which it fit, and the funny thing is that it fit like it was MADE for the dryer. The odd thing is that the Conair looks to have the same kind of nozzle the other blowdryer had, so go figger.

IF you have a blowdryer that marries this diffuser well, this is definitely something you're going to want in your hair arsenal. It'd almost be worth getting a new dryer just to use this, it's that good (one star off for the weirdess of the 'universal' claim.)

title: Best Electric Razor I've Ever Used
text:
[[ASIN:B0009MFUOA Philips Norelco 8140XL SpeedXL Men's Shaver]]
I made the mistake last year of buying my first foil type razor from Amazon(Braun 360 Complete)after using a Norelco rotary for years. I only wish I could return it since it was much more expensive than the Norelco. After using for almost a year I gave up on it and recently purchased the 8140XL. This is without a doubt the best electric razor I've ever used. It is unbelievably quiet and shaves very close without irritation even on the neck hairs. The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is because it doesn't have an indicator that shows how much charge is remaining and it doesn't charge without a charging stand. Other than that so far I'm very pleased and would highly recommend it.

title: Limited shelf life? Don't stock up.
text: I've ordered this product many times, and have always enjoyed using it.  When you dampen your face and apply the product, it foams up nicely and is a good cleanser.  The last time I ordered this, I put the bottle away in the cupboard, since I still had some cleanser from a previous purchase left to use.  When it came time to open this one recently, it was like I had a completely different product. The liquid dispensed more like a gel, with the consistency of liquid handwashing soap.  It barely foamed up, and didn't seem to be cleansing at all.  When I mentioned this to my hairdresser, she suggested it could be expired.  However, there is no date or anything on the bottle to identify how old it is.  I would like to return it for a (fresh) replacement, but it appears to be too late. So lesson learned.  Don't stock up on this product.

title: Shaves as good as a blade - if you use it right
text:
This is the second 7775X I have owned. The first lasted two years, but this after extensive travel all over the world. It does shave as well as a blade (I use one of those too now and then) if you use it right (see below)

Positives

1) Quick charging - less than an hour to charge.
2) Long lasting - I have used it 10 days without recharging - great if you travel.
3) Seems to prevent ingrown hairs - which is something I run into when I use a blade consistently. My face definitely breaks out much less when I use this razor versus a blade (and I own some expensive blade razors as backup!).
4) So long as you follow instructions (don't press down hard, but when you need to go over an area again, do it firmly) you won't get nicked. Nice when you are in a strange hotel in a strange time zone and waking up jet lagged but needing to look presentable for a meeting.

Negatives

1) A little expensive
2) The shaving lotion cartridges are also expensive - I would just buy a can of regular shaving Gel (eg Edge).
3) Constantly pressing the dispenser for more gel can be a pain in the neck, and you go through those cartridges quickly (one every 10 days at most). If I wanted to redesign this shaver, I would junk the shaving dispensor entirely - I now find it just another moving part with the hinged lid.
4) I wish Norelco had come up with a way for this razor to use a standard charger jack of some kind, as having another electrical cord when I travel (especially one that does not work with multiple corded adaptors such as I-go) means I don't take the cord unless I am gone more than 8-10 days.

To use this right, just buy regular shaving gel, put it on your face, wait 30 seconds for the gel to soften your beard, and go for it. This is the best way I have found to get a clean, smooth shave. Gel in a can also has the advantage of going on thickly (versus the Coolskin dispensor) and not drying up quickly. Also, having a can of the shaving gel when you travel (checked baggage of course) can also come in handy if your Norelco runs out of charge, and you need to switch to that backup Gillette you should have in your shaving kit (I travel with enough cords as it is).

text: So far, so good.  I have used many different lash serums, including Rodan & Fields.  I've only used this product for three days and so far there is no irritation.  If you've never used a lash serum before, it is very easy to put on.  It's almost like applying clear eye liner.  Most lash serums suggest putting on before bed at night.  I can never remember when I go to bed, so I put mine on in the morning when I'm applying my makeup.  For me, this works fine.  I just let it dry for a minute and put my eye liner over it.  I have done that routine with this product and it has done fine.  As with the other ones I've tried, I will also be using it in my eye brows.  In three days I have not noticed a huge difference in the length (I have long lashes anyway), but I have also not noticed any irritation or loss of lashes like I've seen in some.  This is also a great price for eye lash serum.

title: Best Castile Soap I've Ever Used
text: My skin is very dry and sensitive, and my hands have a particularly bad case of dryness.  This soap is just wonderful.  No scents to make me itch, only wonderful coconut oil castile.  Without taking care of my hands, and the rest of my skin, it will crack, split, and bleed.  However, no one would know because I take good care of my skin.  I was delightfully surprised with the gentleness, yet thoroughness of the cleaning of this soap.  I don't really think I'd ever go back to other castiles again.  I'm so happy that it came with three bars.  By the way, do not let it sit in an area of your bath or shower if you bring it in there, where the water will constantly get at it.  This bar is so pure that it will melt away quickly with that amount of exposure to water.  Kept in a non-soaking spot, it lasts and lasts.  I'm very happy with this soap and will purchase it again and again.

It comes in a stick (similar to deodorant) that has a screw-top lid, and a little plastic protective cover on top of the cleanser that can be removed and discarded. The cleanser has charcoal in it so it's black in color. The stick format is very easy to apply. You can feel the eucalyptus and it is a bit tingly and refreshing. Fortunately the charcoal residue has rinsed off nicely and not left any residue in the bottom of the shower. This stick will last through quite a while and the price per use is very reasonable. I'm impressed with the quality of this and feel refreshed every time I use it.

title: It works ... and looks pretty.
text: I ended up with re-occurring toenail fungus. For me it was "Piggy Paste", which I made sure to apply every night and while the nails don't look pretty while they are growing out, you can see them improving and getting nice and smooth and pink again.  I decided to use Dr.'s Remedy Enriched Nail Polish, once the nail was mostly grown out and both a preventative and to cover the still yellowed area of my nail.  I have been using it successfully for 8 months and there is no sign of the fungus reoccurrence.  The polish itself is good quality, goes on nicely with a creamy rich color. There is a nice assortment of colors - I purchased mine during the early spring in anticipation of Spring and summer so the colors reflect that season. I am considering buying more - but it is an expensive product. It would be nice if they would offer a multiple colors for less money deal.  But regardless - I have pretty, fungus free, toenails and I am delighted.

title: Give your face a beauty massage!
text:
Before receiving Jane & Co.'s Roller and Gua Sha, I had never really used anything like it on my skin before. For me, it was simply wash, dry, moisturize and occasionally use makeup.

The roller and Gua Sha that I received is supposedly made of Jade. To me, it looked more like New Zealand Nephrite or even Aventurine. The packaging and product are nicely done, complete with a handwritten note from the proprietress of Jane & Co.

There is a small pamphlet with a set of instructions that includes a contact number where you can send a text to receive a complete guide on how to use both the roller and the Gua Sha. Instantly, you are given a URl to download the free eBook to go with the product.

To use either the roller or Gua Sha you simply chill the implements in the refrigerator or freezer. This extra coolness helps to shrink the pores and ease any puffiness that might be present.

Wash your face as normal to avoid pushing any dirt or impurities in your skin with the roller. Dry your face and apply a moisturizing oil such as coconut oil, jojoba, or argan oil which are particularly nourishing to the skin.

Take your now-cool roller and roll over your face, from the center outward. The included instructions suggest to pay particular attention to the area around the nose and under the eyes to aid in the draining and circulation of the lymph glands in those areas.

To use the Gua Sha, again, cleanse the face, and moisturize with an oil that is beneficial for the skin. Never, Never NEVER use mineral oil on the face (or anywhere else on the body for that matter).

Using moderate yet firm pressure in a gentle scraping motion to ease out tension from the face. I confess I haven't quite gotten the hang of the Gua Sha yet, but I am still working on it. The coolness of these facial tools feels excellent on my skin and it definitely is a relaxing practice to get into regularly.

title: Good for beginners
text:
I like cream contour sticks. I normally use the Fenty Skinstick but I'm always looking for a more affordable option.

This stick was nice. It applies easily, is creamy and has a decent pigment. I had no problem blending it. Overall I think it's a good product.

For me personally, I don't think the highlight shade was the most flattering on my medium olive skin tone. It was a little too light and had glitter. The glitter was ok, but I'd like a highlight to use all over the face without glitter.

I probably won't be replacing my Fenty stick for this but it's worth giving it a try. Especially if you are a beginner and just want to try it out.

title: Very good soap
text:
I would call this a very good soap. Not quite excellent, due to a couple of peeves, but very close. No 5 Star, but 9 out of 10.

The scent is quite enjoyable and is as labeled, a bay rum and orange. While it is not overpowering; I kind of would have preferred the orange to be a bit toned back to let more of the bay rum through. But I would count that more of a personal preference.

It works more or less as one would expect for cleaning. I found that it formed a light lather with just hand rubbing and would need a washcloth to build a thicker foam. After cleaning, it would rinse off easily with no leftover films or feelings other than just clean.

This soap is also very good for a wet shave. While I am relatively new to wet shaving and only have used a puck of Col Conk to compare to. Once that puck of Col Conk was gone, my bar of this soap was just about done and I tossed the last sliver into my bowl. This soap lathers up beautifully thick with a badger hair brush, and then after application, would stay foamed on the face for the full shave. If anything, I would say this soap is superior to the Col Conk for shaving, and the Conk was a good product and is highly rated.
Heck. If Frannie sold this soap in a round cake suitable for a shave bowl, I would probably stick with it for shaving.

This soap lathers up beautifully thick with a badger hair brush, and then after application, would stay foamed on the face for the full shave. title: Very nice quality product
text: I appreciate a good facial cream, as I used to use regular mens body cream to moisturize my face.  That worked ok, but I found that it would sometimes leave me feeling a little greasy.  This cream is thick yet not too greasy at all.  It does leave my face feeling very nicely moisturized, and never dry. The quantity doesn't seem like a lot, but for this cream, a little goes a long way.  So I doubt I'll run out anytime soon.  I also appreciate that it doesn't really have a scent, though a nice scent sometimes isn't all bad.  I just can't stand creams that are over perfumed, and to be honest, it doesn't seem like a great idea to me to add scent to something that goes on the sensitive skin of ones face, so I appreciate that this one does not.  All in all, I have been using it for a few weeks, and have had good moisturizing results, which does well to reduce wrinkles in the long run.  I find that moisturizing is a fine line because too much can cause acne, not enough can cause acne, but this one plays in the Goldilocks zone of just right.  I'll certainly keep using it, and do recommend it.

title: Synthetic blend? Lasted one month...
text:
Purchased hair and installed a traditional sew in on 3/16/19.
I did a deep condition and sealed wefts. Bundles were full, no shedding and silky.
Week two: I went to my back stylist for a refresh, hair was still silky, no tangles, I could run my fingers through my wand curls.
Week four: I began to notice frayed ends that looked bushy and nest like. I ran back to my stylist for another wash and set. My hair became very TANGLED during the wash. It was tangled at the beginning of the track and tangled at the ends. My stylist almost broke her brush trying to fix it, the hair was shedding like CRAZY and she was pulling out hairballs from her brush. She finally combed it out, cut off the dead ends and worked a miracle but the hair still feels ROUGH like a synthetic blend and I'm not able to run my fingers completely through without catching. This hair is just OK and will last you no more than three weeks...I will uninstall after Easter.

title: It's alright but not for me...
text: Ok so. Here are my thoughts. The hair itself is nice. It's soft, it didn't have much of a smell when it came out the pack which is good. No tangles and it's still soft after washing and drying. Cons of this hair it's way too thin for my taste and does not blend well. I have had real virgin Indian hair directly from the temples. Obviously in comparison this is inferior quality BUT if you just want something quick it will do the job I guess. Overall I'm not very pleased with this hair because of the thickness and the fact that it doesn't blend with my hair besides my haircolor. It would take at least 5 bundles to make this an appropriate thickness for my tastes but my head is not big enough for all that. So if you don't mind thinner hair and your hair is finer this will be nice, but if you want full and voluptuous, this is not it.

title: Was first skeptical....
text: Honestly, when I took this out of the box I thought, "geesh...I just wasted 18 dollars," but I gave it a shot on my incredibly long, wavy, crazy hair, and it was worth every penny.  This brush is very light and unassuming.  The bristle design helps tremendously with tangles, something I have to battle multiple times per day.  I usually cringe at the thought of brushing my hair out after a shower, since, it typically is a tedious and painful battle, but I commend the designers of these brushes.  For the first time in my life I didn't have to spend 30 minutes of my day picking through my hair with a comb/brush, in front of a mirror, and ripping out multiple rats.  The design of this brush cuts down on detangling time and did not cause me the pain that I am used to.  Not to mention, it doesn't rip out a handful of hair every time I brush with it either.  Worth the cost.  Give it a shot.

text:
To me retinol is a magic serum!! It's great for anti aging. Also acne! Retinol can unclog pores. Also reduce their appearance. After a few uses. My friends were asking if I changed my makeup. They said my skin looked so smooth!! Later in the week my kids asked if I took a nap. They said I looked well rested. The retinol helped my makeup from not settling in the fine lines. My makeup also seemed to have lasted longer. I didn't need as many touch ups!
The thing about retinol is that it can be very drying. It's suggested to follow retinol with a OZ Naturals moisturizer. I use 'Sea Infused Herbal Moisturizer ' by OZ Naturals. It helped tremendously. I don't have any red or dry patches. Also only use this at night. The retinol and the sun could cause a bad reaction. It was very easy to put this product as part of my nighttime ritual.

title: Thick, rich, and natural moisturizer
text:
I'm on the "Youth Express" -- as the bottle says -- with this moisturizer. The list of ingredients takes up the entire length of the bottle, but it's good, "98% natural" stuff: organic aloe, organic sunflower oil, avocado oil, green tea, rose hip oil -- you name it, if you've seen it in the healthfood store, it's probably in this moisturizer.

The first time you use it, you'll have to pump the lid several times to get the lotion going. The dispenser is handy, allowing you to dispense the amount you want. The moisturizer is thick and has an aroma I can only describe as "earthy" or "plant-y." It's definitely not perfumed. The moisturizer works into the skin nicely without leaving residue on the hands. I did notice, several minutes after rubbing it in, that my fingers felt so satiny-soft -- so they were moisturized too. My hands can become pretty dry so I am using this for them as well as my face.

I prefer this moisturizer for winter because it's so thick, but you could use it year-round. Recommended.

title: These are neat.
text:
We bought this to mix rubbing alcohol and aloe Vera for a makeshift hand sanitizer since it's so hard to find during the pandemic. These functioned perfectly and the extras were a nice touch.

Pros
1. Hasn't leaked yet.
2. Easy to fill, easy to empty, easy to clean.
3. The toothbrush covers are a nice touch.

Neutral
1. Larger than expected. Not a bad thing but definitely not pocket sized.
2. It's a bit difficult to control the flow if the stuff inside is a bit looser. In other words, it works better for lotion than it does hand sanitizer.

Cons
1. I am worried about long term durability. These are bottles technically, but they're very squishy and don't have a lot of structural integrity. Don't put heavy stuff on top of it lol. This one goes in the top of the travel bag.

Overall, these are nice little things. They are rashing squishy, hence the worry about long term durability. However, we put our hand sanitizer mix in there and it hasn't leaked out so I'm a satisfied customer.

title: Smooth and scentless
text:
I am very happy with this oil. This is the first time I've tried a fractionated coconut oil rather than regular cold pressed, and I was very surprised and happy with the differences between the two.

This fractionated coconut oil is liquid at all times, which is the purpose of it of course, but it has a wonderful feel to it that is not at all what you would expect after using a regular coconut oil. It absorbs quite well into the skin and doesn't leave behind any sticky or slimy residue.

There is no discernable odor to this oil at all, so using it as a carrier oil for essential oil blends or anything with added fragrance will not be polluted by an undesirable scent.

I love that the bottle come with both a regular bottle top or pump cap. This makes it easy to chose which style will best suit your needs.

I would definitely recommend this oil to someone looking for an unscented carrier oil.

title: Easily to apply and you get 50 of them!
text:
Just like my title says, they are easy to apply. The instructions tell you to wet the actual strip and then put it on your face, but I recommend keeping the strip dry and just lightly wet the area around your nose. I tried both ways and for some reason, wetting my face just worked much nicer. You also get 50 of them so thats a huge plus considering the price.

Now the big question.....do they work?
Well. When I used it the two times, it dude pull out some small blackheads and looked like it did a decent job. I've always been a little skeptical of these kinds of products and I don't feel like it does that much in general. I kind of use these for placebo and catharsis. It's comforting to see these strips pull ANYTHING out of your skin, so it makes me feel better about it. But it is completely acne-clearing and black head cleansing? Not really.

These are inexpensive, you get a bunch of them, and they are nice to use. I recommend it but if you have somewhat large pores and oily skin like me, don't expect much passed "Oh.....well that's nice." I wish it did more. But these are okay.

title: Simple Scent Free Skin Care Absorbs Easily Does It Do What It Says?
text:
I am always on the lookout for really nice simple skin care. Let's take a look at this ampule.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a clear solution that comes out with an eye dropper.

HOW TO USE
The idea is that you use a toner on your CLEAN face, apply this to the face and neck and chest, and then follow up with a moisturizer.

WHAT DOES IT PROMISE TO DO?
This promises to lighted dark spots, and add firmness, glow, and hydration.

DOES IT DO WHAT IT SAYS?
I used this with another Korean toner which is pretty simple, and also the BE PLAIN Aqua moisturizer. When used, this did not seem to moisturize that much on its own, and for brightness and glow, I would say not over WOW factor after using for a month.

DID SKIN LOOK FIRMER?
I guess you could say my skin looked a bit firmer, but nothing so dramatic that people said, "WOW, WHAT ARE YOU USING ON YOUR FACE?"

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a scent free, easy to use serum for the face. It works well with moisturizer, is simple, scent free, and gives a moderate amount of what it says it will do. It is not remarkable, but it is not terrible either.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is decent, but not my favorite product at this point.

title: Perfect trio of products for clean and healthy skin.
text:
This combo is heaven! The foaming face wash is light and gentle, and is equally effective in both summer and winter months. I have sensitive skin that develops dry patches, itchy rashes, (or both at once) if I use a product with remotely harsh ingredients. The foam cleanser spreads generously, so it lasts for quite a long time, and it rinses off very easily, reducing the need for unnecessary scrubbing and rubbing. For the last 10 years since I discovered this line, Caudalie has never caused such reactions. The scent is also quite pleasant.

The serum really helps restore elasticity and mousture with ZERO oily feel on the skin. It is one of the very few products labeled "serum" that I find perfectly suitable to use morning and night, before another moisturizer (or without), and under primer and makeup. Again, it's perfect for sensitive skin. It's not lying about helping replenish moisture. It's especially great in the colder months to counter the dry air and constant temperature changes.

The night cream is absolutely fantastic, even without the serum (but using them together is basically a guarantee that you'll wake up with healthy- looking and healthy- feeling, clean skin). It spreads well, so a little goes a long way, absorbs quickly but isn't "disappeared" to the point your face gets dry in the night, and is not cakey or oily (you won't leave a lotion stain on your pillowcase). title: NO GEL REVIEW
text:
i purchased both the chrome and holographic powders, however i DID NOT use gel nail polish. I know these powders are meant for gel, but i used regular nail polish and the picture polish Revolution glitter base coat and foil top coat.

Starting with the holo, i just could not get the pigment on my nails! i tried it first on my bare nail (with the base coat) and saw the holo tilt, but no actual color. kind of like a holo top coat or something. then i tried it on my nail with regular black polish on the bottom, picture polish revolution on top of that, then the holo powder. unfortunately i got the same result. this way had a few tiny patches where it looked like it would cover the black polish, but for the most part it still just looked like a topcoat.

Now for the chrome. I honestly LOVE the chrome powder. i tried it first on my bare nail with just the base coat, and it made a thin layer of silver chrome, pretty transparent, but it just looked like a sheer shimmer polish. i thought it was really pretty and totally kept it on for about 2 weeks. After that I tried the same black polish with the base coat on top and then powder. The chrome CAME THROUGH. the chrome looks great on top of the black, but i wasnt able to get it to cover my nail completely (had a few patches that were just thinly covered) but i blame that mostly on myself, and not the powder.

overall i 100% recommend the chrome powder. I personally would skip the holographic unless you just want light coverage

When I first got these, I thought I must’ve been sent a child size because they seemed so small. But, after wearing them I see that they are fine. They can get kind of “sweaty,” I guess it’s from condensation from breath, but I’ve only noticed it a couple of times. That probably depends on the temperature outside.
Overall, this is a nice simple upgrade to cloth and disposable masks.

title: Decent shaver
text: I bought this to replace my older Norelco 965RX which can no longer hold charge. For the price, it is certainly look and feel a lot cheaper than my 10+ years 965RX. It shave about the same as the 965RX but lacks the battery life indicator, longer charge time, larger AC cord and no travel case. The saving grace for this model is that it has a low battery indicator unlike the newer Norelco 73xx or even the 7130/7140. The head is also all plastic with no adjustment (except for the steel blades and combs) unlike the all metal of the old. The head is definitely flexing more than the old but I am not sure if it really cut any closer than the old "Lift and Cut" blades. This shaver have both slots and foil on the shaver combs to get closer shave and I think it helps on short stubbles. It does have a nice feature that my old Norelco could not do: washable head. The trimmer is similar to the old which I think is much better than the version on the expensive Arcitec which is not sliding out at all to be useful.

title: Not bad minus the lack of volume :(
text:
I needed a new gray wig and after browsing through the same popular brands on Amazon I decided to take a chance and give this wig a shot...regardless of having only one (one star) review. But I’m glad I did though! The other reviewer mentioned that this unit was too thin but if you look at the pictures I posted, I can assure you it’s not. And the color was spot on; It was the perfect amount of gray and silver and platinum that changed shades depending on the different lighting. The part was decent but still needed some extra plucking and some concealer to blend the lace. (I didn’t have it glued down for the photos so you can still see the lace). As for the styling, personally I like more of a beach or body wave so I need to redo the style but I did straighten it out a bit to relax the curls and it took the heat very well.
I only had two complaints: the roots laid sooo flat and the hairline was way too round. The hairline was pre plucked but way too evenly thinned so it still looked kinda fake and the roundness had me pluckin hairs for what seemed like hours lol. I guess I could YouTube some tricks on how to give this girl some volume because now that’s the only thing missing from her!
For the price, you get more than what you paid for...just be ready to spend some quality time giving her some TLC :)

title: It works.
text:
Really well. I was surprised that it got all the coarse hair from my nether regions. And inner thighs. It doesn't get completely baby butt bald though. My first attempt, I had hair over half inch long. The area under my tummy where the happy trail is, was the area that didn't get thoroughly smooth. The rest, like the um.. sack was smooth and hairless. First run. I was impressed. So I ran a second attempt to get the happy trail area smooth and more hairless. It only got marginally smoother. And I burned my inner thigh a bit.

It's pretty easy to use. Just cake on, hang out for 15 minutes. And hop in the shower. Put the glove on and just wipe away. The effects last about 2 weeks or so. Then I did it again. once. And it got the whole area pretty smooth. Again, the happy trail area was just... not as smooth. But for the record I have super thick hair down there.

I totally recommend this product. The whole kit works like a charm.

title: quiet and convenient
text:
This razor is my second norelco rotary, my first is a 5100 series about 20 years old. Compared to that, this razor is much cleaner, quieter, and more comfortable. The new razor doesn't *sound* like it turns the blades as fast or as powerfully as my corded dinosaur, but it seems to me that it cuts more effectively, which is what I hoped for.

Cleaning this new razor is a breeze - just a quick rinse under hot tap water and I'm done. Having cleaned it this way, I can't imagine paying for the extra cleaning station and chemicals - I note with some interest that the printed user instructions and website FAQ also recommend the hot tap water cleaning method...

Comparing my shave to a triple-blade disposable system I use, the electric doesn't cut quite as close - I can't tell immediately after shaving (my face feels smoothly shaved in either case), but I notice stubble somewhat earlier with the electric razor.

I shave about once a day - maybe 5-10 minutes or so. So far, the battery life is about a month as advertised. Very convenient indeed.

title: Like Magic
text:
I'm not a paid shill, nor did I receive a free product for this review, I bought it here on Amazon for $20 bucks and I will say it was $20 very well spent. This conditioner is amazing, I put it on at night and in the AM, holy smokes my beard is pillow soft and very tame and manageable. My beard actually looks better in the morning when I wake up, then it does after shower and styling.....lol....and I have a long, grey beard that is all over the place generally. I don't even bother rinsing it out and I have not seen any build up or anything.

I had been using the new liquid Scotch Porter leave in conditioner and for only $4 or $5 bucks more this Beard Octane one is WAY better, its not even remotely close. This is weightless, easy to apply and does not leave your beard sticky or straw like at all.....I can not say the same for SP.

I'm so impressed with this product, I'm almost considering ditching my whole current beard regiment and going primarily to only Beard Octane products.

title: Works great!
text:
Top it off (gloss) is a big hit. It does a great job with sealing your gel manicure and lasting a long time. I appreciate that isn’t too thick and gloppy.

The matte top coat is an odd duck. It’s not suuuuper-matte, but it works really well for my purposes. I have a crazy nail (after a little accident) with a thin vertical strip that constantly splits. If you imagine that would be painful, you would be correct, so I cover that nail in clear gel polish. The matte-ness is pretty close to the sheen of a natural nail so it’s not immediately obvious unless you look super close (and even then). So I don’t have to wear nail polish if I don’t want to, but if I do, I can just paint regular polish over this. And if you use a non-acetone polish remover, you can even switch shades without this coming off.

The only reason I knock off a star is because the matte isn’t impervious, and it will pick up fabric dyes and other colorants fairly easily. Sometimes I’ll look down and notice that one nail is looking pretty grey (like the lenses on sunglasses), which is frustrating.

Take off is not too bad. Those crazy clips that hold cotton pads to your fingertips and some acetone will make short work of this in about 15 minutes with no scratching that damages your nail plate. People whine that gel is bad for your nails, but if I remove it properly, it doesn’t hurt them a bit, at least not in my experience. In fact, my nails grow pretty long and strong with this on.

title: They won't stay on for long, even with glue
text:
I'd love these if they stayed on.
I used the sticky sheets provided first, after properly prepping my nails and using the dashing diva prep polish which is made for press on nails. They came off within a few hours or less.
I then used glue after reprepping and still, they do not stick.
It's unfortunate there are not more nails provided for the price but I am glad they are reusable.

As a tip for anyone else, use a no stick uv top coat to keep the pattern and design intact. I used clear but you can use matte of course.

Overall:
I would say not worth the price unfortunately. I'm not sure why they do not make them like other press ons like dashing diva, similar price, more nails and sizes.

title: Cute, and manageable, but...
text: I loved this wig, and yes it was past tense. Wigs work well for me because I receive a lot of migraine and headache injections. This wig has the perfect clip positioning, great ventilation, easily adjustable, well put together. However, you know when you buy a wig and you want to clean it prior to storage? Well, be very careful. I suggest condition, rinse well, place clips, bobby pins, and straight hair pins; to prevent the monofilament lace from being pulled, use moisturizer and detangle spray well covered, and of course comb from bottom to top using a wig or wide tooth comb first, and then a wig brush. I found that the slightest miscalculated snag caused the wig to rip from the beginning to end of the part. I purchased the same with straight hair, but I haven't reviewed it yet. Actually, I am wearing it in my profile picture; how about that.

title: I Love Love Love this Stuff.
text:
This stuff is amazing! I have tried extensions, false strip lashes and individual lashes and they always drive me crazy by the end of the day. Plus every time I use the glue I end up breaking and pulling out lashes. My lashes were getting short and stubby and really quite ugly. I have always had little lashes and so I thought I would at least try this stuff to see if it would help regrow and heal my lashes. It took a couple of weeks of using it religiously to see a difference but then I really started to notice.

For the first time the tips of my eyelashes were touching the skin under my brows! I was so excited! They length looked like I had false individual lashes on without mascara! The bottle did last a lot longer than it said it would so that was nice as it isn't super cheap. I put it on at night, in bed, gliding it along the line I'd put eyeliner (takes practice without a mirror ). I had very sparse lashes and are now filled in and double the length and darker. It took 3-4 months before I saw growth and now after a year, I use it on alternate nights, sometimes putting extra virgin olive oil or glycerin on them and growth is maintained. With mascara, it looks like I have extensions. At age 55, I love it. I was paying $24-28/ tube that lasted 2 months. The ONLY unfortunate thing was that some of them grew, but in a different direction so thy didn't quit curl up like the others but that is probably just my body rather than the serum. Oh, slight redness in eye if you put it on and keep eye in use (daytime use rather than sleeping) but no iris color change like is possible with LashRevive. (Rapid lash is NOT prescription but for me, works as well.) You do have to keep using it, or they will go back to the way they were. But that's fine with me because they look so nice it's worth it! I totally recommend this, just have a little patience.

title: Made me Break Out a Little
text: I bought this product after seeing a beauty blogger's review about it. Since I have hyper pigmentation from not using sun screen in my youth, I've been trying to find ways to stop or reverse it. I also bought and tried out other products in conjunction with this one as part of a skin care routine, but I noticed that my skin would break out in very small pimples sometimes. After testing and leaving out products to figure out what was making my skin like this, I discovered that when I stopped using this product, I no longer got those small pimples. My skin is somewhat sensitive, so maybe that's one of the reasons, or some ingredient I'm slightly allergic to? I'm not sure. But I wasn't completely surprised as I did notice my face felt just a tad tingly and extra sensitive after using it (even with just one drop, no more than two, each night). During the time I did use it, which was for a few weeks, I have about half the bottle left, I didn't notice my spots lightening or even staying the same. Actually, they got very slightly darker; even though, I used sun screen. I don't necessarily attribute that occurrence to this product though, but certainly I was disappointed that this did nothing for me even after being patient and using it consistently for a while to see its effects. Maybe it'll work for others as the other reviews seem to suggest.

title: AMAZING PRODUCT but scent too strong and only found in small bottle
text:
I have thick curly coily AA hair.

It smells a tad too strong and perfumy, and does remind me of waterfalls and springs. It is thicker and creamier than other Suave naturals. It provides great slip, makes my hair soft and fluffy hours after drying, and my hair curls instantly, which lets me know my hair is moisturized.

Waterfall Mist is a great conditioner but not the best Suave bargain. You can find it in stores for as low as $0.85-$1, but it's only available in 12 ounces, whereas Suave Coconut is $1.50 for 33 ounces. So in the long run, this particular scent is not the best purchase for your money. My favorite Suave is Everlasting Sunshine and Coconut, which work even more amazingly on my hair but come in larger sizing with more pleasant scents. For this reason I would not repurchase this particular scent again even though I had a great experience with it. If you don't mind paying the same price for less product and really like the scent, then this is a great buy for you.

title: Surprisingly Good For A Costume Wig
text:
So I wear and review a lot of wigs and I have started breaking the review down into sections that I think will be helpful.

Color - The color is very similar to the person pictured wearing it in the examples but not the one that is on the mannequin look. This wig is very light silver / grey. It is not that fake, overly shiny texture, and is the same solid color throughout.

Styling- This has an adjustable headband and is fairly easy to fit and style. As it is a costume wig you have to be careful if you are looking to pull it back for anything as the amount of hair in the wig is really designed more for it to be worn as is (which is normal for this kind of price point)

Comfort - This wig is light and comfortable and there is plenty of airflow. This was a little weird around my ears (because my head is a little smaller) but nothing too difficult. This would be suitable to wear all day although I personally wouldn't.

Overall - I really liked it but for what it was - a costume wig. If you are looking for something for a Halloween type look this is perfect.Great for pictures and videos but not one I would probably wear out (other than possibly to a costume party if it completed the look) just because I have others that look way more realistic.

Styling- This has an adjustable headband and is fairly easy to fit and style. As it is a costume wig you have to be careful if you are looking to pull it back for anything as the amount of hair in the wig is really designed more for it to be worn as is (which is normal for this kind of price point)

Comfort - This wig is light and comfortable and there is plenty of airflow. This was a little weird around my ears (because my head is a little smaller) but nothing too difficult. This would be suitable to wear all day although I personally wouldn't.

Overall - I really liked it but for what it was - a costume wig. If you are looking for something for a Halloween type look this is perfect.Great for pictures and videos but not one I would probably wear out (other than possibly to a costume party if it completed the look) just because I have others that look way more realistic.

title: Interesting cream
text:
Has a light lemony scent, the cream feels great when you massage it onto the face. After a minute or two of massage and you let it set for a bit, it turn into an oily texture and during that process you can feel this tingly sensation all over your face (this feeling supposedly indicates that the cream-to-oil is removing/absorbing the impurities, sebum and dirt from your pores that your 1st cleanser didn't get). After another minute or two, you remove it with a cotton pad and once you swipe your face of the oil, you should see some yellow residue on it indicating all the impurities, sebum and dirt you missed. I've tried this out on the back of my hand and forearm as will as on my face a few time and there's a lot less yellow residue on the cotton pad I use for the back of my hand and forearm vs. my face. I do feel that it works but with an already 10 step skincare routine, it takes a lot of time to do the whole skincare routine.
I don't think those with oily skin will like the feeling of when the cream turns to oil, I had dry skin and now am back to normal to combo skin, and don't mind the feeling.

It appears that the description of the brush has been updated and now includes detailed dimensions.  This was my first horsehair shave brush. It is softer than a boar brush and has more backbone than badger brushes. This makes it ideal for use with both hard soaps and soft creams. Although this is a small brush, it still creates a superb lather. I liked it so much in spite of its size that I ordered one of its larger siblings, the Vie Long 13071. Both are great brushes and both are attractive additions to my shave cabinet.

title: Great for dry skin
text:
I use this product daily as part of my evening routine. Not only is the lotion soothing and moisturizing, it also has a relaxing lavender scent. The scent starts out strong - then fades - so it's not annoying. I wash my hands a lot during the day and wash dishes as well. This has made a difference in how soothed my skin feels in the evening.

It seems to absorb in pretty well after a minute or two, which is nice. No greasy feel here.

It comes packaged in individual gift boxes, which are OK looking. If I were giving this to a friend I might take it out of the box and tie a ribbon on it instead. The tubes are marketed as "travel size" and they are small enough to tuck into a bag or a med/large purse.

It's not sticky or gooey.  It just absorbs quickly and evenly.

I think this product is great for cleaning the teeth, As for whitening though id say I haven't seen a difference and I've been using twice a day for four days. I will continue to use this product for probably a month because I've seen some reviews saying results take a while. I will update with results

title: They Are Not Bad 👩
text:
I received 3 packs of "Revive Rinse Free Bathing Wipes". Each pack contains 12 wipes.

I wanted to try these wipes because I thought they could be a better option for me than regular baby wipes for my period accident clean ups & they are pretty nice (not perfect).

I have heavy extended length menstrual periods and have always used regular baby wipes for any messy / accident clean ups. That way I can just throw them away after I'm done with them.

These bathing wipes are way larger than a typical baby wipe. They are white in color and have a light perfume type of scent (which is probably the Chamomile Extract).

They can be microwaved (for no more than 15 seconds according to the pack) if you wanted them warm but I just used them "as is" right out of the packs.

They are wet enough to get the job done but not dripping wet (leaking) everywhere. They are also a nice thickness and soft to the touch.

They didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. They also aren't soapy at all, they left my skin feeling okay (clean) maybe a little bit sticky but nothing that I couldn't tolerate.

I do like these wipes overall because they are large in size and affordable.

title: Yes! Its worth the $$ and Yes! it performs!
text:
I was using a cheaper model rotary style brush for the previous 2 years when it finally broke. They used a thin metal that reached all the way up into the brush. It rusted and snapped. I pulled it apart and found it was about as thick as a the metal in a small paperclip. Braun uses a much thicker metal stem system that does not go all the way up to the brush, but rather the brush is made to reach down to the stem. Much better build quality. Much easier to dry off if you want to and being at least 3 times thicker it will last for years compared to the other brush.
When I researched the heck out of Electric brushes, I found the Braun 3D Excel was #1. Yes, it topped the famous sonicare. Sonicare does a better job advertising while I spent less $$ and have a better product doing what it should be doing. Cleaning my teeth. I do tell people about this product. Its something that actually lives up to its repuation. Its one of the great products in my opinion. After about a week of using mine, I ordered another and had it sent to my mom.
When I first turned it on, I was impressed already. I could tell it was high quality. Then I began using everyday and have done so for over 1 month now. I love the timer and try to brush 2x a day as recommended. Its great and my teeth have improved. I can tell they are smoother and whiter and feel much better. I can feel that my gums and teeth have tightened a little better where I used to feel bigger gaps when flossing. I will never go back to using a stick brush and I can only imagine how impressive the next generation of electric toothbrushes will be. Awesome already and if they improve on this, it will be amazing. If youre too cheap for Amazon, they can be found on ebay too. Its worth the money especially when it keeps the dentist away. I rate this product 5 huge STARS. Get it and you wont regret it.

My skin feels and looks more radiant and I think it keeps breakouts at bay -- I have noticed a significant drop in breakouts since starting to use Moringa Oil. It doesn't smell great -- it sort of smells like dirt -- but it is not off-putting and again, I mix it with an oil that has ylang ylang in it so I don't even notice the smell as long as I mix it. I like that this brand is organic -- I am not worried about putting pesticides on my face because of that.

This stuff is AMAZING. I am in LOVE. I will never again gauge my ears without this. At first I thought, "Why buy this one? There are much cheaper types out there." (I know this isn't expensive but c'mon, we're all looking for a bargain!) So I found a couple of different types but this stretching balm had the best reviews by far - I always trust the reviews.

So I bought it.

I am seriously amazed by what this stuff can do. I have always stretched my ears, technically "dry" before I bought this, and it doesn't feel great. After a hot shower, I would push in a new size and I had to push and push and it would usually tear and bleed and throb for days afterward. Not fun at all. They say that if you stretch it improperly, it will never heal or be able to shrink back to the small size. And I like to go back and forth from regular sized earrings to a double zero gauge - so it's important to me that my holes will shrink back.

ANYWAY. I bought this stuff and freaked out. I lathered my ears up with it and, like a freaking miracle, the gauges slipped right into my ear! I had just tried one size up, the DAY before and it hurt so badly that I couldn't even get them in. For some reason, when you use this stuff, you ears just take it! The next size up went into my ear, very easily, no pushing, no bleeding, no tearing, no throbbing! I was SHOCKED. It was so incredible! I actually can't wait to go up another size! I am so excited because it's EASY to stretch my ears now!

Don't think about it anymore, just BUY IT. This stuff is miraculous. You will not regret this purchase.

title: Not as purple as the picture
text:
This wig is more black than purple in real life, but I think it looks better that way. It seems to be a nice, high quality costume wig able to fit various head sizes. The tall braid standing up is thick and plump, not likely to deflate or fall over on its own, but it does make the wig a little unbalanced. A real person will be able to compensate easily, but my little foam head here was struggling.

This set came with a wig cap, earrings (one had a defect on the "gem"), a necklace that was lightweight, a spider clip for the hair, and two braid clips. I wasn't really sure what to do with the braid clips or how to clip them into the hair, as there didn't seem to be any flexibility in the prongs to get hair between them, but some searching revealed that they probably should be twisted up around the braid. I did that, as pictured, and you can see how I was able to hide the way the main braid was held in place with a rubber band at the end.

All in all, this was a fun little set that I think a fan of the movie Hocus Pocus will get a laugh at. It might not be the most faithful recreation, but if you don't have the time or skills to make this hairstyle for yourself, it will suit a cosplay nicely.

title: disappointed
text:
I bought the 22% gel because it was closest to the 16% that I had used 8 years ago with professionally made trays and to what my dentist recommends.
After 21 days, my teeth are no whiter. I first used this gel by Watts as directed, once a day for 45 minutes. After a week I saw no results. So I increased the amount of gel, still with no results. Then I used it twice a day, and finally used it overnight.
My teeth, which are slightly stained from teas, are no whiter.
My dentist says it takes about 3 months using 16%. He also recommends brushing my teeth within a hour of drinking tea.
I have not used the product now for 3 weeks. My teeth are no yellower than when I started. I am only brushing them after every cup of tea.
The 16% gel I bought from my dentist 8 years ago took about 6 weeks of everyday overnight use to change very yellow teeth (53 years of living and lots of tea) to white. I could see the change on a weekly basis.
Since this stronger product by Watts gives no results in even 3 weeks on less stained teeth, I am very disappointed.

title: Works for Eye Puffiness & Amazing Off-Label Headache Relief!!
text:
This eye cream was far different than I was expecting -- but in a GREAT way. I'm 29-years-old, so the lines around my eyes aren't terribly deep, although they are probably deeper than many other females my age due to my sun-worshiping in earlier years. I do suffer, however, from severe seasonal allergies and am constantly plagued with dark circles ("allergic shiners" as they call them) and extreme puffiness of both my upper eyelids and just under my eyes (the infamous "bags").

To be honest, my impression of this cream at first glance wasn't too great. For starters, the jar of cream was much smaller than I had imagined, but I guess that's my fault for not noticing the (very) small-printed "0.5 fl oz" on the label in the picture. (I do think that this was a little deceitful though, because the size/amount of this cream is not listed anywhere on the product description.) In addition, while trying to read the teeny tiny print on the jar, I also almost immediately noticed a spelling typo on the front of the label that reads "Nautral & Healthy" rather than "Natural & Healthy." I know this seems like a rather minuscule and knit-picky detail to point out, but it did make me at least wonder about this company's quality control standards.

Despite my initial impression, I gave the company/cream the benefit of the doubt and have been using it for the last few days. With my first application under my eyes, the cream felt more on the "thin" side (similar to a lotion rather than thick cream), but while rubbing the cream into my skin in a circular motion, the moisture that the cream delivered was far better than I anticipated. It takes at least 3-4 minutes before your skin feels like the cream is completely absorbed, which gave me ample time to slowly massage the area during absorption (and felt very soothing and relaxing). I had absolutely no issues with any side effects or skin reactions such as burning, tingling, redness, or irritation. I noticed a small "immediate" reduction in the pores and fine lines of the areas I applied the cream, though not as impressive as some of the Retinol and Vitamin C serums that I've used in the past. There was no obvious difference in the dark circles or puffiness right after application, however, within about 30-45min, the puffiness started to visibly decrease and the area all around my eyes felt less tender/achy in general.

With each subsequent application, I noticed the same resulting decrease in puffiness as was observed initially. My puffiness did return each morning, but I expected because I'm still constantly being exposed to my allergens. (After all, the cream is meant to relieve a symptom of my allergies, not be a miracle cure for my chronic systemic condition.) I've noticed that if I apply the cream immediately before bed and spend more time rubbing it into my skin in the circular motions, I do have a noticeable decrease in the morning when I wake up compared to before I started using the cream. As far as the under-eye dark circles, I can't tell a difference so far - but in all fairness, I've only been using the cream for 4 days (twice daily) so there's still hope.

Now for the best part (in my opinion, at least). On the second night of using this cream, I had yet another one of my throbbing headaches (allergies are the worst!!) text: I planned on using this as additional length for my undercut hair style. I knew there was something wrong when I took it out of the package m, ran my fingers through it and it instantly strands were between my fingers. Not a great sign.  My stylist upon initial installation, remarked this was “bad” hair. This was marketed as human, but this is a human blend at best; good synthetic at worst. If she was unable to work with it as a professional it would have been a hot mess in my hands. The dye line is severe-there is an inch of black and a ton of the gold; it doesn’t blend or gradually merge into the gold. I was glad to still have hair left from my original two packs of actual human hair to complete the style. I won’t be fooled again.

title: Whiter teeth after first use!
text:
I was a bit hesitant to try this kit because it is the first kit that I have tried that did not involve whitening strips. This teeth whitening kit did what it was made to do, it did whiten my teeth about 3 shades whiter. This is really easy and simple to use. You apply the product into the supplied retainers and put them on. After I removed the retainers, I did notice a whiter smile. My teeth were not sensitive like they usually are with whitening strips, and I was able to eat and drink without irritation. I am giving this product four stars because while the result was great, the "gel" tastes a bit gross. I was able to tolerate it because it is a teeth whitening product. But it goes into my mouth, and I can't help but taste the product, and it just doesn't taste good.

*received at discount/free

title: Pretty good rotary shaver
text:
When I was a teenager I got a Norelco as a gift and at first I got a really good shave, I really liked it over a razor. Then, I started to get such bad rashes that I finally had to give it up and went back to a razor for about 25 years.

I was too dumb to know that you had to periodically replace the heads. I just assumed that they lasted forever. Oh well.

My first new electric was a Remington, and I'll say that their adverstisements, for me, were true; It gave the closest electric shave.

The problem was my beard grows at a steep angel to the skin and electrics have a hard time getting all of the whiskers. If you missed a whisker on day one, you might get it on day two, but after that, forget it.

I went to a Braun after the Remington wore out, and it has a coarse cutter on the inside that can get those errant whiskers. It was not quite as close as the Remington, but was a lot faster because it would find the longer hairs.

This has all been to give background to the Norelco.

I've had it for over 2 months now.

It falls somewhere in between the other two. It is not quite as close as either, but very close to the Braun.

It will get those stray whiskers usually, but every 4 or 5 days, I need to use the trimmer to get ones that have gotten away.

As far as irritation goes, it borders right on the edge of a problem on my neck. The cause is obvious. The screens on this rotary are a lot rougher that a foil shaver. That is to say that you can feel the grid of depressions and holes. Be careful in pressing too hard or using repeated passes, to avoid irritation.

Because of the large surface area of the heads, I find shaving to be about 1/3 faster now, as long as I don't try to get a blade quality shave.

This razor is extremely quiet, with only a very soft whirring versus the loud buzz of any foil.

The trimmer works adequately with my only complaint that it does not lock in the up position. If you push it the wrong way, it folds back down.

The batteries last 3 to 4 weeks on a charge. If it starts to get low I just plug it in and continue shaving. To get around the lack of a low battery indicator I will charge it up before a trip so that I don't need to take the charger with me.

I consider the lack of an indicator to be a non-issue.

Overall I like the shaver a lot

I liked the way they shaped my ends, though of course they were extremely dull. So I finally decided to invest in a nice pair of thinning shears and settled on Mosher because of their reviews and price. I'm very happy with them, plus I like the included carrying case because both pairs of shears fit nicely in it. Some reviewers complained about the quality of the case - yes, it is not a fancy case and it's cheaply made; however, it beats the plastic bag I was using and it provides solid protection for my shears.

title: A great shave with a few quirks
text:
I bought this shaving system in the hopes that it could make shaving a bit less painful, as I've always had fairly sensitive skin. In the few months I've owned it, I've been very pleased with the performance and the overall results. Here are a few things I've found...

Pros:
- The moisturizing system does work very well. I get substantially less skin irritation than I have in previous razors that I've used.
- I've discovered I enjoy shaving in the shower. I always tried to avoid mixing shaving before a shower due to the irritation, but this works well.
- The charging and refill system is nice (more on this later).
- Comfortable to hold and use.
- I shave more often using this than any other razor I've used previously.

Cons:
- You'll be compelled to shave daily, since it works best and most efficiently that way. That can be a pro or a con, depending on your lifestyle.
- While the charge and refill station is great, it seems that I always run out of moisturizer before running out of battery, so I have to remember to refill it myself, since they suggest not leaving the razor on charge all the time.
- I haven't found a great shower mirror yet, so I wind up starting my shave prior to the shower, to trim around sideburns and the like.
- Works better as a wet razor than as a dry one.
- While I like the scent of the moisturizer, it took me a bit to get used to it.

Overall, I'm very pleased with this razor and would suggest it to anyone looking for a new electric. If you are OK with the pros and cons, then I say go for it, you won't regret it!
