title: Pretty stretchy and thin but OK for price
text:
These spiral ties from Gomayee are very handy. They are inexpensive. Except for the original brand of these, all of the ones I have found on Amazon have the little rough and uneven part where the the circle is completed. Thicker bands definitely have it show less though. The lower the gauge (if this is the same way earring posts are measured) the better the tie.

These are extremely thin and stretchy. I have a couple of photos with blue text that show the difference. The thick one is actually too big for my thinner hair. These are also rather loose on my thin hair. I have some smaller ones with thick plastic that are my favorites. I would think these are good for big buns and maybe for thicker hair? I can twist them around about 4 times for a pony tail. Still they don’t damage or tangle my hair and I will use them. They feel fine on my wrist too for when I take it out and don’t want to lose it.

title: Not as good as the old Advantage
text:
I'm a long-time blade shaver, but every 3-4 years I go on an electric shaver kick and use it for about a year. I've never found a single electric razor that shaves as close as a blade, but I used to own a Norelco Advantage that gave a decently close shave that was pretty comfortable and didn't irritate my neck.

This is supposed to be the upgrade to the Advantage, but after just a few days of use my neck is chewed up far worse than it ever has been with any other electric. It's annoying enough that I'm not willing to "wait it out" for the 30-day trial period that Norelco recommends, and I'll be returning it next week.

That being said, I can see from the other ratings that many people have had a lot of success with this shaver. Part of my problem may be that I'm a shaving perfectionist and if I'm not getting a close shave in a given area I'll go over it again a few times until the hairs are cut off. It boggles my mind that I can run an electric shaver over a patch of stubble and the stubble will sit there, unaffected, as if nothing at all had happened. You don't see that happening with blades...

So in summary:
Pros: auto-filling lotion cartridge, waterproof, quick charging, does glide well over face (no irritation WHILE shaving, but boy you'll feel it later)
Cons: seems to cause ingrown hairs at a higher rate than its predecessors, very high neck irritation, lotion seems to drip off of razor head while shaving, not a very close shave. NO ELECTRIC IS EVER AS CLOSE AS A BLADE, so I wish that Norelco and Braun would stop claiming such.

title: Love the Coconut Baby & will try others...
text: ***  Just received the Limited Edition "Sugar Cookie" in the mail today.  My 21-month-old daughter is already asking for a bath while yelling "yummy" -- yes, it smells great! *****  I first tried Sweet Baby Organics Shampoo & Wash in Coconut Baby for my daughter last fall when she was 10 months old.  I liked the scent right away, but I was also impressed with the fact that it rinsed so clean.  I have tried other natural and organic baby washes with a coconut base, and they seemed to leave a "film" on my baby -- I liked that this formula was rich, and thick, without being sticky.  It's true that the foaming is minimal when comparing Sweet Baby Organics to washes with chemical lathering agents (such as SLS) but I found the lather from the coconut base to be "just right" without being bubbly.  We live in Kenya, so when I buy on Amazon I have to wait for my family to send me a box in the mail, or for someone to come over to visit (last fall I brought a supply of it back in my luggage).  My next package arrives in April, and this time we are trying the Vanilla Baby scent. The shampoo is NOT tear-free, but again, that is because of the lack of numbing chemicals in it's formulation -- I simply hold one hand over my daughter's forehead, and rinse her hair with a cup of clean water in my other hand.  One other fact to note is that a little goes a long way.  At first I was concerned that there were only 8oz bottles available, but even at 15 months old, a dime-sized amount cleans my daughter's entire head and body (though I have to admit that being a blondie, she doesn't have a whole lot of hair yet).

1. after taking off my eyelashes it would leave a black and sticky residue which was really hard to wash off (i recommend taking it off with coconut oil)

2. i didn't cut the tip to big because i didn't want that much product to come out, but lately too much has literally been pouring out.

3. Another thing i noticed is that it is starting to like burn my eye a bit, not to extreme, but it should happen.

If you are looking for an eyelash glue, please buy the Ardell one. I switched to it and its perfect.

title: Great for Spa Nights at Home!
text:
I love these! They puff up in liquid like little marshmallows, and are easy to peel apart to form the full mask. It works for my face size/shape just fine (a smidge small for men maybe). They appear to be high quality, and I love that they're individually wrapped! I throw these in my travel bags to use with my serums and lotions, and give them away for people interested. I've used these with blended aloe vera, gels, serums, hyaluronic acid, high moisture "lotions" and so much more.

I usually remove the packaging, drop the "tablet" into the well-mixed up liquid/gel concoction I chose that day, and wait for it to puff up. Then I peel it apart to form the full mask, plop it back in the liquid/gel to absorb some more, and throw it in the fridge (because I like the masks cold). I use these after showering and cleaning my face, and watch tv or read with it on. Once I feel the edges start to feel slightly dry, I peel it off and massage the rest of it into my skin, and top off with another moisturizer before bed.

I liked these so much, I bought a package for my mom too! Do note, the ones I received were actually in a blue bag, with blue writing on the individual packaging.

title: Excellent Hold, I'm Really Impressed
text:
I bought this specifically because of the anti-humidity and anti-frizz claims. I had an outdoor garden party to attend and we thought it might be damp. It turned out to be dry, so I can't speak on the humidity factor as of yet, but I can say I was extremely impressed regardless. I did my hair in the morning, traveled a couple hours away to a party where I sat outside all day long on a fairly windy day. Not strong winds, but more than a breeze for sure. I brought the bottle in my bag but I never needed to use it to touch up. I then drove home 16 hours later and went straight to bed because I was exhausted. I woke up the next day and my hair still looked good!

It's a fast drying "freeze-hold" type spray. It's a bit stiff to the touch but it doesn't look stiff at all, and it comes out easily later when you brush it. I have thinning, fine hair so it was important to me that my "strategic styling" to cover the thinner areas held in place and this did the trick, so I'm sold. The scent isn't pleasing but it's not bad either, a little perfumey but I can deal with it for the great hold I get. This is the best bottle of hairspray I've tried in the last couple of decades actually.

Since I didn't have enough time to get another wig, I just used super glue and brushed the hair upwards so that it would look like it went into the ponytail. It worked for me, but I was upset that I had to do a bunch of work to make the wig look good. Also I would not recommend using super glue without a window open. 😬😞
Would not recommend buying this.

text:

This formula has almost zero lubrication. I had to use several handfuls to shave my head because it kept running down my face. It literally felt like using just white water with no lubricant whatsoever.

I finally had to use some bar soap just to get enough lubrication to finish shaving my head.

I don't know why they changed formula, but they need to go back to research and development on this one!!!

title: Impressive eye brush cleaner for in between colors
text: I bought this after watching some youtube reviews and decided I would try it out.  I don't have very many brushes and it is a pain to wash them and then wait for them to dry before I could use them again.  I thought trying this would help me switch colors without having to dirty another brush.  I was a little skeptical that this thing would actually work, but I tried it as soon as I got it and I was pretty impressed that it took the shadow right off a brush with fresh product on it.  The only thing I found with this that is not great is that if you use a sparkly pigment or shadow, it doesn't get all the sparkly particles off the brush and some of that can transfer to your next shadow.  But otherwise, the Colour Switch is impressive and I was surprised at how well it worked with regular shadows.  The tin is also nice since it catches any shadow that trickles through the sponge, it also seems like it will be great to travel with since it won't get make up everywhere if you toss it in a makeup bag.  They do sell refills for the tin, but I think I will just wash the one it came with and see how that works out.  Overall, I am pretty impressed with this brush cleaner and would recommend it to people looking for an easy way to clean your eye brushes between colors.

title: A Fantastic Investment!
text:
This thing is amazing! I use it on the go to touch up both powder and my cream foundations (depending on the weather, I'll wear one or the other, but never both because I hate cakiness and fine lines that get set into place with powder when used over other foundations).
To touch up my powder foundation, I push the brush all the way up and lightly swirl over my powder compact, then gently dust over my face as needed. For my cream foundation (Olay Age Defying cream foundation; I use their Age Defying primer for both foundation types though), I leave it sunken down into its tube and use the stabilized bristles to smudge out the little fine lines I get from smiling so much, or to gently blend in whatever cream foundation I occasionally apply with the sponge that comes with the cream compact.
Sometimes I also use it for touching up my powder blush with the first method I described.
This brush is super polish, soft, and durable. The travel case is nice and thick, surviving drops to the floor lol. It's easy and smooth to operate as well! A total pleasure, truly.
I've not been paid or compensated in any way for my review.

title: Close to Perfect
text:
Quite a while back my Remington Microscreen needed the screen replaced, and for a few dollars more than the cost of the screen I bought Norelco's bottom-end cordless. It was under-powered, seemed like it was always at the end of the 30-minute shave time, and didn't cut well at all. All of the people I know who use a Norelco love them, and said that in Summer you won't get the razor burn on your neck you get with a screen razor, so I bought the 8894XL.
The shave is good, and when set to the softest setting the heads easily hug your face. (A firmer setting caused some razor burn, noticeable in hot weather only.) It's amazingly quite and powerful, shaves quickly, and cleans up easily. It doesn't shave as close as the Microscreen, nor as well my dad's corded Norelco of 15 years, which he almost never changes blades on. I have naturally wavy and very thick hair, which it misses occasionally, but is nothing to complain about. A quick shave only takes 3 minutes; a detailed shave takes 7. It takes some time to trim around high sideburns accurately and the area under the nose, and is useless for trimming extra eyebrow hair, all of which the screen razor does well.
As far as features go, they're great. It really does charge in an hour and last 100 minutes. I let mine go past the 0 minutes left warning the first few charges until the motor slowed regularly while shaving and then recharged it. (It automatically turns off when the motor can't stay close to normal speed.--recharge before this.) It lasts about 170 minutes, and the readout gets closer to the actual run time each charge cycle. Once you set the firmness to what you want it doesn't need to be adjusted again. The pop-up trimmer could be better, and is kind of like a plastic knife that's hard to cut yourself or anything else with, and doesn't bog the motor. The clear LED cover scratches amazingly easily, so you'll want to keep the razor in the thin bag when not in use. The cleaning indicator is accurate, and rinsing under hot water, blowing the water out of the inside, and drying the outside with a towel is quick and easy. Just keep the trimmer extended until the razor air-dries completely. I haven't heard any complaints about the battery other than online, so it may be the problem is fixed in the newer razors.
In summary, it's a fun razor that won't wake the family early mornings while giving you a quick shave. There's no razor burn when the firmness is set correctly, but it also won't shave as close as a blade or screen razor. There's no guessing on how long the battery will last, which is at least 100 minutes.

The picture above shows my old styler brush in the middle and their (Milantia) brushes on either side.

Anyway, I found the Jinri on Amazon and ordered that one, it looks exactly like the one I have. 1000W is the same as my old one. YAHOO

title: Natural, organic, vegan & revitalizing retinol serum! Rejuvenates the skin :)
text:

Reseliney uses all natural and certified organic ingredients, which I absolutely love! My face is very sensitive and oily and I am so pleased at how wonderful this retinol serum works to keep my face looking vibrant without breakouts or irritation. This serum contains natural antioxidants and vitamins that my face require to stay firm and wrinkle free. Retseliney uses only organic, natural and vegan ingredients to insure that the retinol serum is top quality and chemical free for better results. I absolutely love this serum and use it during my morning routine. My face looks bright and radiant and I can feel the glow!

The serum is small enough to fit in my carry on bag and fit in my purse with my cosmetics. I am very satisfied with this serum and will be purchasing another bottle once I run out. I would highly recommend this product to my friends and family! Retseliney has helped my skin rejuvenate and feel alive with their high quality retinol serum and all natural ingredients.

title: Super soft and silky results! Works fast on breakage and split ends!
text:
Wow! I've tried a lot of different Argan Oil shampoo and conditioners (and sprays and masks and hot treatments etc) and I can 100% say this is my All time favorite for no other reason than how incredibly fast I'm seeing a difference in the ends and improvement on breakage. I color my hair and have been for close to 10 years now and just in the past year or so I've started having really bad problems with breakage and split ends. I've tried probably 10 different brands or more with some kind of argan oil treatment and it really helps. But I didn't get results like this from anywhere else, and I've tried some pretty pricey stuff. After like, 3 days of use I happened to look down at my hair one day and it just hit me that I didn't have any frizz or areas that looked wild and untamed from breakage, the hairs that would normally have 2 or 3 splits or frays were just smooth all the way down. I tried to take a picture of the hair up close so you could see but couldn't get a clear shot at such a short distance. The color looks richer and has a healthy looking shine, it isn't greasy or stringy like you might worry about with Argan Oil.
This stuff even smells amazing! I usually like coconut scents, it's always been my favorite, but this smells more floral and a little spicy, which maybe sounds weird but I think it's soooo good.

It lathers up surprisingly well for an Argan Oil shampoo and I don't have to use much for my bra strap length hair. My hair is really thick, too, but a good quarter sized dallop works out to be about the right amount for me. I do the ends and body first and work my way up to my scalp, backwards from how I use regular shampoo. (I do this because some brands seem to leave my hair oily if I don't get it rinsed out well, that Argan Oil can be stubborn.) I usually let it set for a couple minutes while I wash my body so the hair can absorb the nutrients before I rinse it away. I follow it with their conditioner and my hair gets sooo soft when it dries. I really can't stress enough how well it helps my hair. I know everyone responds differently but for me, it's better than anything else I've tried. I'll be ordering this again for sure.

I did receive my Argain oil shampoo at a promotional price for testing and evaluation purposes. I was not paid for my review and was asked only to provide whatever feedback I may have about the product, whether it be positive or negative. I welcome both positive or negative feedback as well. My review is solely based on my experience and honest opinions of this shampoo.

title: LAURA MERCIER WHO?
text:
Coming from a devoted Laura Mercier translucent setting powder user.... I LOVE THIS SETTING POWDER.
If you are debating between the two... here is my advice as a person who had originally oily skin that is now normal - dry due to accutane.

If your skin is oily - this product may not be for you. It is a super fine and soft powder that feels less tight and not as drying as the laura mercier.. but i find it to lay on my skin better.
If your skin is normal to dry - This is the product for you. The particles are so fine that they lay on your face like a cloud. I literally just dust is over my entire face with a big kabuki brush over my it cosmetics cc cream and VOI LA ! "perfect" skin.

NO FLASHBACK - DOESN'T SETTLE INTO LINES - seriously don't be discouraged from trying this powder. Laura Mercier who?

The only con - SO MUCH OF THE PRODUCT COMES OUT. Seriously its so fine that it comes out easily and sometimes poofs in the air like a cloud.
I just realized that since its a lighter powder - i need to be more gentle with my technique of taking it out.

text: I always buy and use Krieger's regular soft gel bottle and I bought this not knowing that it was a "hard hold gel" and simply thought it was the same soft gel in an easier-to-squeeze container. If you want a product that really keeps your hair-style through the whole day, I highly recommend this; however, be prepared to scrub your head hard and use a lot of shampoo/conditioner. Aside from that, I'll be sticking to Krieger's regular soft hold gel.

title: Leaked Out
text:
I was excited to get my package today...but was quickly disappointed when I discovered that the toner had leaked all over the box and half of it was already missing.

NOTE: nothing in this box was sealed! The box itself wasn’t even sealed. The opening you see in the photo is literally a hole in the box (no plastic film) and none of the bottles had any kind of sealant or plastic wrap to prevent the lids from coming loose or the products from being tampered with. I suspect this is why the toner leaked out everywhere.

That being said, I tried out the products tonight and was highly impressed with the emulsion and the face cream. Both are heavy and rich and super moisturizing. A little goes a long way with the face cream as well so I think that tiny container will actually last for quite a while. The toner and essence were okay, but didn’t leave enough of an impact to really form any kind of first impression about them. I could honestly see myself buying larger versions of the emulsion and face cream though!

Despite my love for the emulsion, I had some difficulty getting it out of the container. It didn’t have a pump on it like the essence did and is of such a thick consistency that I was literally banging the bottle on the palm of my hand trying to use gravity to force it out.

All in all, the products are okay but the packaging and bottle style aren’t exactly top notch. I’m not fond of receiving unsealed products.

The serum is kind of thick but absorbs quickly into your skin. Your skin stays tacky for about an hour or so. After that it becomes fairly nice and soft.

The serum does have a scent to it but I can't describe it. It is fairly nice though so no complaints there. I have had no negative skin reactions or issues when I used this product. This to me is a little over average.

title: Norelco finally got it right!
text:
I have used electric razors for over 35 years all have good points and all have weaknesses. Norelco razors have two problems.

Hard to clean. As the cutter and blades fill up the motor is not able to maintain the speed and nicks result. You must take the blade and cutter assembly apart to clean properly and if you cut longer hairs by accident(side burn area etc.) it will wrap around the cutting blade and really slow the motor down. The motor slowing is the worst on the new "3 blade" called the Speed XL, they just seem to be underpowered.(just as a note the older Spectra blade replacements fit these razors and seem to work better). Think of this problem like a paper shredder that has not beeen emptied and hasn't room for more papers in the bin.

Hidden Build up. I have changed batteries in several of my Norelco shavers and the build up of gunk where only disassembly could find and cure it, is remarkable(same with most brands). I suspect this is gunk is high in bacteria and the cause of most skin infections from nicks. The stuff you never knew was there is nasty!

Now for the cure: Norelco 8060x! This razor blade assembly has open backs for the stubble to fall through as you shave. I use mine in the shower so no mess. The blade assembly is completely seperate from the motor unit= no place for gunk to build up! The unit is entirely water proof. The blades disassemble easily so you can get at those occasional "longer hairs" that wrap around the cutters. The cutters have more blades on each, so the shave is faster and the motor seems stronger than previous models, hence less slowing. The Nivea solution is great, but you can use regular shave cream or gel. I like the Nivea Gel for Sensitive Skin, it seems to be the right thickness for the razor and works alomost as well as the cream you load in the razor.

The only negative for some people might be the size or shape of the handle, it is smaleer and lighter than most shavers. Some people with larger hands may find is inconvient and others may find it easy to drop.

Overall this is the best all around razor I have owned, there is a brief time required for your face to get used to any new razor... This ones worth it!!

title: I didn't think this would work, the cost is so affordable but it really does work!
text:
I was a little skeptical, it's a brand I've never heard of. The price was right and reviews helped push me toward trying it out. When I received the item, first thing was the scent. I really don't like the way it smells but that's not all that big of a deal. It's satiny when applied, a small amount goes a long way. So I needed something more instant for the bags under my eyes every morning. It does have better instant effects than my usual, which is great; but the scent turns me off.

Update: I know I don't take good pics but this is all natural, no filters. I'm self-conscious about my eyebrows so..... Anyway, I've had a very, very, very hard few days and I haven't really slept. So I get up this morning and I go look in the mirror, expecting horrible bags and dark circles under my eyes. Lo and behold, I have very, very little swelling or discoloration. It has to be this product cause I've been using only this product on my eyes. I have a couple other products I would like to try, but I think I might try out the other products in this companies products.

title: I'd recommend googling some info about them before buying
text:
If you've never used a boar bristle brush before (or any natural type of natural bristle, I suspect), I'd recommend googling some info about them before buying. You don't use them quite the same way you'd use a brush with hard plastic bristles. You definitely want to comb the tangles out of your hair first, for example, and wait until your hair is dry to brush it. (Maybe you're supposed to do those things anyway, for all I know -- I have shorter hair so it's easier for me to use brushes incorrectly without too much damage, but I find plastic brushes more forgiving.)

Because of those things, I'm not sure a boar bristle brush would be great for styling my hair -- but I didn't buy it for that anyway. I bought it more as a type of hair treatment, to get the benefits of boar bristle brushing: distributing oils evenly, improving the condition of the hair, stimulating the scalp, extending time between washes, etc. I have oily hair, but all that oil just build up on my scalp. With this brush, my hair feels and looks much more balanced. I do get some static while brushing, but it settles down quickly.

The brush itself is durable, seems high quality, and has a ton of nice stiff bristles. It feels great on my scalp, and I love being able to help my hair's health without having to slather on a ton of extra treatment products!

title: Dark circles are brighter, the eyes look more awake, and the skin is supple and in prime condition as a base for makeup.
text: This is Jacob's wife writing the review of the Valentia True Glow Eye Cream. My biggest problem spot when applying makeup is the dark circles under my eyes. So, naturally, I am interested in products that claim to solve this problem. The Valentia True Glow Eye cream comes with beautiful packaging, an easy to use nozzle for dispersion, and simple to follow instructions for application. I tried the eye cream both at night before bed to see the overnight results and also in the morning before makeup application. I liked using the cream right before makeup application the best. It works well as an eye cream, but I like the fresh and well rested effect I get when I put it on in the morning. The cream feels a bit tacky to the touch a few moments after application, but this effect quickly fades as the cream soaks into the delicate skin around the eyes. I have very sensitive skin, and there was not a trace of stinging or irritation. The product has a pleasant and subtle smell. I love that this product uses great ingredients. You can tell how high quality the product is when you smooth it onto your eyes. The eye cream gets a 5 star rating from me for all of these reasons, but mostly because it simply works. It isn't magic, and it doesn't claim to be concealer, but it drastically improves the condition of the under eye area. Dark circles are brighter, the eyes look more awake, and the skin is supple and in prime condition as a base for makeup application.

text: The Dry Look, at last look, was selling (if one can still find it as the quantities dwindle) for many times its old retail price.  The reason is that Gillette, after acquiring it, closed it down, terminating its manufacture.  This is one of those bizarre business decisions that to outsiders, seems incredible.  It's reminiscent of the Coca Cola blunder of 1985 when the company replaced the great formula of Coca Cola with what tasted like carbonated pancake syrup.  In this case, it's just another fine product now in the past (at least at this writing, one can only hope).  PLEASE NOTE After a long search I found SUAVE non-aerosol, unscented to be equal to The Dry Look but you pay less than $3.00 for 12 oz instead of from $110 to #150 for the Dry Look.  Forget that it's sold for women and comes in a pink container.  Hair is hair.  I still have a half full original DRY LOOK and it is virtually identical.

title: Great for touch-ups
text:
After years of electrolysis, every once in a while, I will get a stray hair that pops up. I don't really feel like driving the hour to the nearest electrologist and buying a whole session for just one hair. For this purpose, this little machine is excellent.
If you've never had electrolysis, I wouldn't recommend it. Knowing what to expect this to feel like has helped me use it effectively.
Looking to remove all the hair on your legs? Unless you want to take this on as a full time job, I wouldn't recommend it. It is very slow.
The included tweezers are next to useless. You probably have some at home that work. Use those.
Since I am not professionally trained, and this is not a professional machine, I find it is easiest to use on thick hairs. I have a very difficult time trying to use the probe on thin hairs.
Like the other reviewers, I find the beep annoying. I'm sure there could have been a better way to design this to indicate when the current is on. But at least I know it's working.
At this price, for touch-ups, it is perfect. Keep your expectations in line with the price.

Again, I loved how they look, so I did try to work with them about 3 times.

title: Grew My Thinning Hair
text: This gel actually filled in my hair. My hair had thinned out on the top thanks to menopause and heredity. I absolutely saw results. It took about 6 months of use before I noticed my hair filled in. I used it two to three times a  week to slick down my bun. However, I can no longer use it. Sadly, my face does not like biotin. I didn’t make the connection that the gel was breaking my face out until very recently. I started battling adult acne around the time I started using it and attributed it to hormones. I tried prescription Retin-A, ProActivMd, Differin Gel and many other things over the past year and a half. Nothing cleared it up. Recently, I replaced it with Xtreme Wetline because I wanted more hold. After only a week of not using it, my face completely cleared.  If you’re looking for hair growth, this works! If you’re sensitive to biotin, be mindful of possible breakouts.

These tape-ins are also pretty affordable compared to other brands I’ve seen.

title: Great for curly hair
text:
I've been using Eufora products for maybe 10 years or more now? I love all of the products I have used. I have naturally curly hair which can be prone to being frizzy or dry, and these products really help. Some I use regularly and others on occasion. The scent on this stuff is amazing.

In fact one of the reasons I got so hooked on trying this stuff was because my hair dresser uses them along with many other products and I was always going around smelling how good she smelled and wondering what perfum she was wearing. However this is the type of scent that doesn't interfere with regular perfumes.

It reminds me of just a light natural scent you might get if you walked by a flower stand. Not overwhelming or sweet or musky but just light and fresh. I get a lot of comments on my hair smelling nice as well.

I use these products:

1. Moisture solution conditioner - regular conditioner
2. Moisture cleanse shampoo - regular shampoo
3. Hydration leave in conditioner - leave-in conditioner
4. Urgent Repair - on occasion as special treatment
5. Beautifying serum - to tame frizz and dead ends daily
6. Sculpture Styling Glaze - when I need some hold on occasion
7. Illuminate Shine Mist - to finish off a look with a light gloss
8. Fortifi Strength Spray - daily to enhance strength of hair
9. Pure Polish Finishing Drops - Works the same as the beautifying serum, except I was say for situations when you have especially course, curly or dry hair. Beautifying serum is a little lighter.
10. Curl 'N Defining Solution - when I need some hold on occasion
11. Curl Revitalizer and Spray - when I don't have time to wash my hair and just want to plump up and freshen the scent of my curls
12. Smooth 'N Straightening Balm - on the occasions when I want to straighten my hair
13. Fixation Styling Wax - Tame the baby hairs around the face, the little fly aways with this

title: Best Razor Yet!
text:
I have used over 5 different models of electric razors in the past decade, looking for the cream of the crop: I have think I've found it!
This shaver had good online reviews so I purchased it and it was well worth the money. It takes a little bit of time to get used to your face (about a full month for me) but after it did it was quite a close shave, approaching the closeness of even a manual blade. Other positive things about this model are that it is easy to clean and has a great internal battery (fully charging in less than an hour). LED lights on the front come on after each use and remind you to rinse the razor head under the tap while also reminding you of how much battery life is left. A sturdy stand to keep your razor upright while not in use is also included.

title: We have a Love/Hate relationship as of now!
text: This steamer is AWESOME my hair loves it! The features are great the quality is good. I seen many steamers that were price really high and I found a really great deal on this steamer. The dome is really big and the nape of my hair also get steamed which is a plus. I don't have to change postions just so my entire head get the full use and I love that. The company shipped really fast as well.... FOLLOW UP!! 01/21/2012 OMG! Where do I start, I was in love with this Hair steamer untill it begin to smoke and shut off on me. The plastic cup that holds the water has melted on the side Im not sure what went wrong today but this is crazy. It started off perfect and now I am wondering what went wrong I contacted the company via email lets see how this goes....I will keep this matter updated **UPDATE** 01/29/2011)I contact the company via email they did respond back in a day or two with the wrong number for me to call but when I sent  a second email they provided the correct contact info. On 01/23/2012 I spoke to a nice guy in customer service who informed me my warranty had ended and there was nothing he could do for me. I explained to him very calmly how this steamer went south on me, and I am not the only customer having issues with this model. Well I made my point clear, stood firm and he offered to send me a refurb model free of charge. The re-ship was very speedy it arrive just a few days later and it seems to be working better than the new one I purchase back in Sept.2011 It takes sometime to heat up just using the 400 wats but thats ok I will never use both as I agree with another review its just to much power and this may cause your steamer to smoke or overheat and shutoff. Im not sure how long this one will last but I will enjoy it while its working now....On my way to deep condition:))

title: The best shave soap/creme I have ever used!!!
text: The best shaving soap I have ever used. Hands down. I have been wet shaving with a safety razor for over ten years. I have been searching for the perfect shaving soap or creme for the same amount of time. I have used everything from King of Shaves, Proraso, Cremo Creme, etc, and nothing has been as comfortable as the Mitchell's Wool Fat Soap. Its an absolute joy to use. There are a few tricks to using this soap. If you want to see a good video review online, I recommend googling "Mantic,  Mitchell's Wool Fat Shaving Soap." This gentlemen provides great tips on how to get the most out of this shaving soap. For instance, for the best lather, you should use a "Boar Bristle Brush" which is stiffer than a badger brush. I have a "Super Badger Brush" which doesn't make near the lather that the stiffer, boar bristle brush makes during lathering. One last point, as other reviewers have pointed out, this soap does not have a strong scent, its just very subtle and clean. That was a plus for me. If you are looking for something with a stronger scent you may want to look elsewhere.

title: Pretty good.
text:
I bought this to upgrade my lotion dispensing Norelco that's now 5 years old. The battery on it barely lasted one shave and it lived in its charging cradle except when drying.

Since I was so used to the old cradle and how it always was in it, I liked the little clock on this. But once I noticed it lasts < month the cradle is now a relic in my junk drawer! It seriously only needs about an hour to charge fully so there is not any need for the cradle. The tiny (not a huge brick that sticks in the wall) will fit inside the cradle or the razor.

When I first used my 9160XL I really irratated my skin, even being a long time Norelco user. But it went away in about a week. I still get red spots from irratation some times but heres my trick: wait until BEFORE you shower because soap strips all the oils off your face, making it hard to glide or try using a TINY amount of shaving cream, spread so thin you can barely notice it and then go over with a splash of water. If you use alot the Norelco could choke on all the extra cream and become less effective. I hardly notice any differences in irritation when using the <S N> dial (sensitive or normal skin)

The trimer is neat but I only use it to shave my unibrow when I am too lazy to actually pluck the hairs out. The trimer + the head array pop up with a flick of a finger. I was used to pulling open the head like my old Norelco but this is spring loaded. Some how when I was store drying it (the recommend to leave it wide open to air dry out the insides) the head came off. I was frightend! But it is designed to snap on and off easily.

The plastic head cover is working like it should. I just prefer my old head cover more because it was easier to tell which side is going on the top. But it is getting easier the top nub is alot smaller the my old one. The travel case is awesome, fits it like a glove and zippers up. Be sure to leave the cover on for double protection.

Be sure to look for a brush to clean the heads before you throw away the box. The packaging is so complex it took me a while to extract all of it's contents.

More cons:
- I don't like how the heads are unprotected during air drying... I wish the cover would fit while its opened.
- Orange? Bold color for something thats mainly blue, silver and gray.
- Maybe my drain needs draino but when washing out the chamber and heads alot of my hair gets stuck to the side of my sink, requiring splashing until it all goes. But it's kinda cool filling my sink the top then start draining and look up close at all tiny hairs it cuts.

I am been using this for 4 months now.

edit, now it's been 5 years and the battery still holds a pretty decent charge. Still working really well too. Only replaced the blades once so I'd say I got my monies worth.

title: Few things to note…
text:
I’ve only had this shampoo/conditioner for a short time but I already love it. I have thin wavy hair but a lot of it, and have issues with my hair getting oily the day after a wash. This duo has kept my hair feeling fresh and voluminous into day 3 which is amazing!!
But a few things to note…
- This is NOT meant for think hair!! I see the majority of negative reviews have somewhere in there “I have thick hair and…”, no. This duo is specially formulated for people with thin, oily, flat hair. That’s literally the entire point of the “ghost” formula. OF COURSE its not going to work for you thick haired girls because it’s not for your hair problems.
- I agree with a point made by some negative reviews that it’s not very moisturizing, and yeah that’s fair… but that’s also not really the point of the product. If you want a volumizing and oil fighting shampoo and conditioner then get this, if you want a specialized moisturizing shampoo then buy that. So instead, I just use a scalp oil 1x a week, a hair moisturizing mask for thin hair 1x a week, and combined with this… I get best of both worlds!

REALLY happy with it.

title: No noticeable results after over a month - UPDATED 11/9/14
text:
NOTE: I received a free sample of this product to review.

Like the hair on my head, my eyelashes are thin and fine. Without mascara, they are barely noticeable. I have never before tried an eyelash growth serum and was frankly somewhat skeptical, yet at the same time, I was excited at the thought that this product might be beneficial.

This serum is packaged in a tube that looks like mascara. However, the inner wand ends in a tiny brush that is like a VERY thin paintbrush. I would have preferred a slightly thicker applicator; the brush was SO small that it was difficult to see the serum for precise application.

I followed the instructions for this product, applying nightly along my lash line. I used this product daily for over a month (since late August). Unfortunately, I am not able to discern any noticeable results. I actually took photos, thinking that might show more of a difference, I but do not see any changes in the photos, either. (It looks like Amazon has finally posted my photos, so you can see what you think for yourself.)

The only small improvement I have noticed of late is that AFTER applying my mascara, my lashes seem longer than they normally would with mascara--it's almost as if they are somehow adhering to the mascara better than they would normally. I'm not 100% sure if this is a real effect, but that possible sign combined with the fact that I didn't have any adverse reactions to this product is the reason why I gave it two stars rather than one. Perhaps others will have better luck than I did.

UPDATED 11/9/14: Despite my lack of results after one month, I continued to use this product. It has now been over two months, and I believe that I have seen SOME results. At this point, my lashes DO appear longer--I think that's why my mascara has seemed to be working better, as my lashes are a bit longer than before. However, my results have been nothing like the miracles in the photos posted on the product page--yes, my lashes are a bit longer, but the effect is hardly noticeable to the bare eye (I asked my husband, and he didn't notice). Furthermore, my lashes are neither thicker nor more plentiful; this product gave me a bit of length only, not thickness or any other effect. So, in summary, I upgraded my review from two to three stars, but I don't feel like I can go beyond that at this time.

title: So far -- soft, smooth skin!
text:
So far this serum is great! I'll come back and edit it after more prolonged use -- I hope that the long term effects will be good!

I have very sensitive skin and my pores get easily clogged. Honestly I cannot use 80% of skincare products out there and it takes me forever to find something effective yet gentle! This serum rally boosts moisturizing of dry spots and I think it's even smoothing out some of my skin's surface irregularity!! It's a little too soon to be sure but I'm really really hopeful >.<

The serum is super light, smells mildly medicinal (but I prefer that wayyy over putting artificially scented products on my face). It feels like water! I patch tested this product, which means I applied it to just a small part of my face for a while to test it. That's how I can tell of its smoothing effects; that part of my cheek feels soft, smooth, and bouncy. It's not a magical, radical, overnight change, but it's enough of an indication for me to fully integrate this product into my routine.

title: Extends lashes nicely, but makes my eyes itch
text:
To create fine, long lashes, this mascara does a pretty nice job. Lashes look longer and natural.

The primer has itsy-bitsy pieces of fiber in it that adhere to the lash and the comb aligns them to lengthen the lashes. The bits of fiber kind of freaked me out when I kept thinking there were individual lashes sticking to the primer comb. The fibers are part of the lengthening process. With that said, I'm still not sure I like the idea of putting bits of fiber so close to my eyes. The packaging says nothing about being ophthalmologist tested, hypoallergenic, etc., so I don't think I'd recommend this product to anyone with sensitive eyes. After wearing this mascara all day, my eyes begin itching, and it requires more than water to remove.

I really liked wearing this mascara as my eyelashes looked longer and feathery and very natural, but I'm concerned about the ingredients.

I received this product for free in exchange for this review.

title: The Base Enhances Results, Extends Time Between Next Dye
text: I think many guys are just buying the dye because it works well enough on its own.  But after a couple applications of the brown dye alone, I decided to buy the Organic Base just to see if it makes a difference...and it does.  When I just use the dye for 30 minutes and then wash it out, my beard/skin has that ever so slight green tint for the first 24 hrs, then a natural brown color with blondish highlights (where gray used to be) settles in nicely and lasts for about 4 days before the dye's color starts to fade away.  When I use the base first for 20 minutes, wash it out, then apply the brown dye for 20 minutes and wash it out, I don't notice any green tint at all, and the dye's color lasts about 7 days before needing another application.  So for me I'm going to continue to use the base first so I only have to dye my beard once a week to keep it looking good.  Very happy with Grizzly Mountain products.

text:
(12/15/18) I saw a lot of negative reviews about this kit after I purchased it.. I have to say that these are way easier to do than regular acrylics!! I even put tip extensions on with my set a few days ago and so far, so good!! I did end up with a few dips and ridges, but it's been ages since I've done my own nails... 6/25/19: Update to add: In the process of cleaning the brush between uses, the clear coat/finish brush disintegrated in my hand, so it's no longer usable. Also, I have stored the items from the kit in their original bottles, well sealed and in an upright position, and the activator (step 2, a pretty important part of the process) has disappeared (evaporated, completely)!!! I'll never waste my money on the color club brand dip kits again.

title: Measure Your Implements
text:
I should have measured the things that I wanted to hang in this item. My dryer has an oval shaped barrel - won't fit in round cylinder - inserting the handle doesn't work very well. The largest tube will just barely fits my curling iron which has plastic teeth to hold my hair in place. I really like this curling iron and have recently replaced it because the teeth kept falling off. An additional 1/4" diameter on the bigger tube and a crimped bottom would be better for my use. I assume the skinniest tube is also for a curling iron? or maybe a hair brush handle? Bottom line - measure your hair care tools before ordering. Suggest you advertise it with tools inserted.

The unit is heavy, sturdy and will probably last longer than anything you want to use with it. No complaints on the finish which is glossy black.. Ordering it was mistake on my part. Some people will like it a lot.

title: Lights flicker and dim; no override for auto timer
text: I bought this mirror to replace another one purchased from Amazon that I planned to return. However, after using this one for a couple of weeks I ended up keeping that one and returning this one instead. After using this mirror for less than a month, the lights started flickering randomly. The mirror touts an auto timer as an energy saving device, but be aware that you can't override this option. So, while you're using it the mirror will turn itself off. I probably could have lived with that but the flickering lights are just too annoying. It also seems like the lights are noticeably dimmer after just 3 weeks of use. I'm not running it on batteries ... this is with the unit plugged into my wall outlet. And pay attention to the dimensions - at 16" tall, this is one big mirror! On the plus side, I didn't notice any distortion at all in the magnification and the option for the different light tones is nice.

title: Love these
text:
I have been using this style combs for about a decade and absolutely love them. I do not like to have a lot of different holders in my hair. You know, when you need an up-do and it ends up being a rubber band, a barrette and four bobby pins. For me it is too much. And not only to put them in, but especially to take them out at the end of the day.

Well, this comb can hold shoulder length and longer hair in a high knot all by itself. I do not use it for french twist, but rather twist hair into a bun on top of my head and insert the comb front to back. It stays put all day. I can swim, garden, clean for hours and it will not unravel. Also, it is almost unnoticeable.

these particular combs seem to be slightly better quality than the ones I bought last time. There are no chips or catches on plastic and they are higher polish. It seems to me that they will be durable. All combs I bought before last for a couple months each, which is fine since the price is so low. Highly recommend especially for situations when you need to put hair up or down without a mirror (beach, pool, gym etc). Once you learn how to do it - piece of cake....

Once in a medical facility they requested that I remove everything from my hair. The tech was astounded when I just took out this comb and a perfect topknot instantly fell down. Not only did she examine the comb and learned where to order, she also asked permission to show it to her colleagues.

Highly recommend.

title: Easy use
text:
I like having my nails done but I have no patience with painting them and letting them dry. Even when I go to salons, I rush and at least 1 nail gets messed up. That being said I have started to use nail strips recently and love them. I usually use color street but I decided to try out these ones.

First off, I love the color, it looked just like the picture online. The blue is a calming baby blue, almost like a light wash denim. They were easy to apply. I did have to trim one of them because I have a more boxy nail shape on one of my fingers but that's nothing a pair of scissors can't fix. The alcohol prep pad was very thick and easy to use. The nail file was also solid quality for a disposable file. The strips were able to be applied removed, and readjusted without messing up the strip or your nail.

Now for some negatives. Most of this stuff is not bad, its just coming from someone who has been using color street for a few years now. First off, these are single sided nail strips so you cant easily get 2 uses out per side. Separating the nail strips from each other is a bit of a challenge since the protective plastic is a little thick. Overall these strips were a little thick, so filing was hard. Lastly, the blue almost seems printed on, if you stretch the nails a little, the color shows up more white and it looks printed and not solid nail polish.

With all that in mind, I would say none of the negatives are deal breakers. I just wanted to list them so you knew what you were getting into. The sunflowers are nail stickers that I bought off Amazon.

text: Have tried multiple different brands of these hydrocolloid blemish patches and find these to be, hands down, the best. I find that they are easiest applied with tweezers and removed after applying a warm, moist washcloth to them.  They are on the smaller side but I've yet to have a blemish they haven't handled admirably.  And, since my skin is overly sensitive to salicylic acid, I greatly appreciate that these are untreated patches; the straight-up hydrocolloid works just fine.

title: it's ok but I would not recommend it
text:
It was tough to decide whether or not to give this product one or two stars, but I gave it two because it doesn't completely suck, it's just not as good as other razors that aren't as expensive The manufacturer recommends waiting 21 days before deciding to keep this product or send it back. I would also give the same recommendation to people who are looking at purchasing this. I bought it because I needed to replace my old razor. My old Remington titanium R9710 was a good razor but it ripped the hair out of my neck area and left me with very irritated skin. The thing about my old razor is that it had floating heads and it handled long hairs pretty well if I was lazy and didn't shave. This new Arcitec worked very well when I first got it but I really wanted to try it out and only had stubble on my face at the time. It worked very well with short hairs and left me with no irritated skin on my neck.

Well I wanted to see what it would act like if I let my hair grow a little and it did not perform like I thought it would. It took a long time to shave and I had to go over the area multiple times in multiple directions and with different pressures just to get a few long hairs. This new head style has really been a downgrade because when you apply pressure, the heads seem to pull away from your face on the outside part of it and it makes it harder to shave. It was either that or the fact that it doesn't have a hair collection area. It fills up with hair rather quickly so maybe that has an impact on how well it shaves. Cleaning the unit was very simple but I think I would have the cleaning system of one of the speed XL models over this. You have to pop open three separate chambers rather than flip the whole head up to clean each blade. A nice feature of this razor is the tube trimmer. You can take the razor head right off and pop out the trimmer. There really isn't much else to say about the trimmer other than I thought it worked great.

Overall, this is a very nice looking razor, but the functionality of the razor itself is pretty bad. It does come with a nice travel case and charging stand as well. The travel case is made of hard plastic and does not have room for the charger, but it does have the capability to charge the razor, so you do not need to bring along the charging stand. If you want to try this product I would say go for it because Norelco has such a generous return policy and maybe you will like it better than I did. If you think you like the functions of this razor but really aren't sure about it, I would not recommend it because it doesn't work like I think a razor should (it takes a long time to shave and it doesn't work well on longer hairs). It looks nice and has nice features, but I think its functionality isn't worth the high price tag.

title: Great for maintaining those guitar pickin' fingernails
text: OK - so I'm a fingerstyle guitar player (James Taylor / Chet Atkins wannabe). Fingernail care is an annoying part of the business, I'm afraid. And unfortunately, I have a nail that splits often. Silk reinforcements with resin and activator has been a lifesaver for maintaining nails, and this sanding block is part of the process. I use a diamond file to keep the fingernail ends shaped and the sanding block makes the finished ends smooth and snag free. Snagging is NOT good for finger picking guitar! I'm still learning to use it, but it also does a great job of smoothing the nail before applying silk and resin on the split nail and Sally Hanson's triple hard titanium polish on the rest of my nails. Yeah, I get the other guys ribbing me over my shiny nails - which is pretty obvious when they see both hands together - only the right hand gets the fussing. But then they hear me play and the ribbing stops. My only complaint about this would be useful life - it seems to wear down rather quickly. But I'm probably not being fair - that diamond nail file lasts forever - can't expect a soft foam sanding block to last that long.

title: Would not recommend for sensory issues
text:
I purchased these because I have sensory problems and need a way to keep my mask off my face.

I would not recommend these for that use. The design, while cute, is not helpful. It was noticably harder to breathe (compared to other styles, or a mask alone). The flower shaped cut outs ended up being very restricting compared to other mask brakets.

The design also makes these much heavier than other mask brackets. It got pretty uncomfortable very quickly.

The pink was a bit lighter in color than expected.

Material was as expected; soft, pliable, silicon.

I ordered a couple kinds, and did find a different design that worked much better for me.

title: Heavenly scent, great for acne, lips, under eye areas, reasonable price
text: I accidentally put it in my fridge, but this is meant to be solid in room temperature, I believe. It has a wonderful, light, decadently sweet, flowery scent--I'm sure it is not honey though. I am very sensitive about scent. The solid solution is light green, and I recommend using a cotton swab to dig the stuff up. It could be a sticky mess if you use fingers. I use it as an eye cream and sparingly on my lips. But my lips do look wonderful after application--just moist, pinkish and very plump. I have acne-combination skin, so I use this on my blemishes or soon-to-be blemishes. It is not fast-working like some sulfer acid pastes in shops, but it does work. I find the acne spots to be lighter after I use this too. The price is reasonable as well! Loreal eye cream products cost close to 20, and this stuff would last for a quite a long time, I believe. Thank you so much for this product. This is the lengthiest product review I wrote.

I purchased this Coconut and Retinol Anti-Aging Facial Serum because it promotes to being able to say goodbye to forehead wrinkles, crow's feet, turkey necks, and laugh lines. I also read another reviewer where she was applying it to her spots/freckles and I thought why not try it and the spots are definitely lighter. I like the results that I am seeing so far and will continue to use it.

Another big plus is that the Anti-Aging Serum only contains four ingredients, simple and pure; one is coconut and the other is Retinol. There are no harmful chemicals used in this product and it is made in the USA.

I did receive this product at a discounted price for my unbiased and honest review and testing and am very happy with this purchase. All opinions stated are 100% my own and have not been swayed.

title: Easy to mix, works as advertised.
text:
Good variety of scents and benefits. Would make great gifts or stocking stuffers. I do like that some of the same benefits can be found in multiple masks so you can reap the benefits over time instead of just randomly. It would be nice to have it by skin type individually too though.

I like the concept of powder since it doesn’t dry out and it’ll keep longer. It states to use 30 ml of water which if you don’t have anything to measure that, the standard medicine cups are usually marked for that if you have those in your cabinet. I did have to use a tiny bit more as it became a paste initially.

There is a lot of product in each tube. Honestly one could probably get away with using half at a time as the whole tube was enough for me to do down my neck as well and I put it on VERY thick. It does dry down though. If it’s too thin it is harder to peel. My skin felt plumped and moisturized. The scent is a bit artificial but more like a pleasant candle than something sickly sweet. Definitely think it’s a good value for the price.

title: It really works
text:
I have been using Odaban for about a year now and I do have to say it works. After suffering from embarrassing under arm sweat my whole life, this seems to be the only product that works. I do find that it burn quite a bit after application. What I do "for those considering this product". Is I make sure that I shower a couple hours before bed to make sure that my under arms are clean and dry. I apply before bed but with only 1-2 sprays per arm and then I rub it around the entire under arms to make sure It gets everywhere because I notice that if you miss a spot, that spot will sweat.

The burning does happen still, but not as bad. I never used this daily or weekly....but I notice that after a spray, it lasts for about a month for me. When I start to notice sweat, then I reapply and all is well!

They tie at the back of the head with a shimmery white ribbon so they can be adjusted to fit any head size. Each headpiece came individually wrapped in a plastic package & then the 6 packages were kind of stuffed into one big plastic package so they were a bit squashed when I received them. A couple of leaves fell off of 2 of the headpieces but it's a quick fix with a glue gun. In fact, if you want to make a fuller wreath, you could add more flowers with a glue gun as well.
These headpieces are perfect for a princess or fairy birthday party for your little girl, for the flower girl at a wedding, for wearing to a Renaissance Faire, playing dress-up or as a part of a costume.

title: Used for more than a dozen times. Here’s my tips and review.
text:
Okay so I have used this product more than a dozen times more than a year. I love it. Works great for my eye brows. Here is what I have learned:
1. It can stain your counters/sink. Put a towel or rag down. If you do get it on your counters clean immediately. Soft scrub works well!
2. It doesn’t stain your skin. Don’t worry about trying to be neat about it and being detailed to your eye brow. Just slap that crap all over and set your phone timer for however long you want for how dark you want (I prefer 3 mins for a dark brown)
3. Set up. Mixing in that little bowl can be messy. I like to use a Q tip to slowly mix it. This way it does not get everywhere on my brush and I make sure I don’t leave any unmixed powder on my brush when I apply to my face.
4. Clean up. Cleaning that bowl again don’t want to get on the counters when you have extra left in the bowl. I use a baby wipe to get the extra out before rinsing the bowl and brush. This way I make sure my counters stay unstained!

title: My hair is brushed, and no bristles are inside it!
text: I was a bit iffy on buying a hard brush such as these. However, I admit, I do like it. The bristles so far have not broken off, which is a major problem that i have since my hair can be quite curly. A lot of my brushes end up in the bin due to the bristles breaking off. The shape of the brush was difficult to get used to, however, once I got a system down, I found it much better then straight brushes. When I brush, I Hold the top of my hair, and let the rest drape over my arm. I then brush down the length. The curved shape goes over my arm nicely, allowing me to brush the hair I have draped over it that much better. I then let my hair go, and just brush normally. The curve of the brush fits my scalp too great, and feels great while brushing. Getting two at this price is a great value, so I highly recommend these brushes.
